title: Test site is reachable and renders
steps:
1. Open https://test.gokesari.com/
2. Read the page and the browser console
expected: Home page renders with header (logo, Cart, Sign in), a 'Deliver to' location bar and shop shelves. No 500 page. No React hydration error (#418) in the console.

title: Database-backed pages load (no 500s)
steps: 1. Open /shops, /search?q=milk, /categories, one /shops/{slug} page and one /products/{id} page
expected: Every page returns content. None shows a 500 or 'Something went wrong'. Record any that fail with URL and console/network error.
source: Decisions & Deployment: 'test site returns 500 on all database pages'

title: Deployed build matches the code under test
steps:
1. Open each of: /admin/dashboard, /admin/orders, /admin/exceptions, /admin/settings, /admin/suspensions, /admin/rider-earnings, /admin/price-references, /admin/mrp, /admin/shop-categories, /admin/returns, /admin/cod, /admin/risk, /admin/analytics, /admin/campaigns, /admin/societies, /admin/product-master, /admin/consents, /admin/ratings
2. Note which load and which 404/500
expected: All pages load. A 404 means the build on test is older than the features in this suite; a 500 usually means a migration (0025-0037) is not applied. Record the list - it decides which modules below are Blocked.
source: Status report 2-Oct: 'migrations 0025-0036 unapplied as of last dev log'

title: Business-rule defaults are in place before testing
steps:
1. Open /admin/settings
2. Note every rule group and whether 'current' differs from 'default'
expected: Nine rule groups are listed (otp, dispatch, riderEarnings, returns, images, notifications, suspension, mrp, externalPrices). Record any non-default value so later results can be interpreted. Restore defaults unless a case says otherwise.

title: Email (SMTP) is configured on test
steps: 1. Open /signin
expected: The mobile/email sign-in form is shown. If a warning says codes cannot be sent, SMTP is missing: mark every OTP and email-notification case Blocked.

title: Cron jobs are running on test
preconditions: CRON_SECRET supplied by the owner, or cron scheduled on the host
steps:
1. GET /api/cron/daily-orders with the bearer token (health probe)
2. Mark an order READY with no riders online and watch the attempt counter for 2-3 minutes
expected: Health probe returns 200 and generates nothing. The 'Looking for a rider - attempt N' counter rises about once a minute, proving delivery-dispatch cron runs. If it never rises, mark cron-dependent cases Blocked.
source: Test plan section 5.2; QA plan section 0

title: Required test accounts exist and can sign in
steps:
1. Sign in as each account in turn (the owner enters credentials / codes)
2. Check the header role switcher and landing page for each
expected: ADMIN, OPERATOR, 2 SHOP_OWNERs, 2 CUSTOMERs, 1 approved online rider, 1 verified society admin all sign in and land on the right portal.

title: Seed data is sufficient
steps: 1. Confirm: Shop A approved, delivering, pinned location, stock >= 20 on 3+ products, one packaged product with an MRP; Shop B approved in the same PIN selling at least one of the same master products at a different price; Customer 1 has an address with coordinates inside Shop A's radius and wallet >= Rs 2,000 One loose product (sold by weight) in the master. Category X with at least 5 master products: one with no catalogue price, one loose, one already listed by Shop A. Shop C approved with no products.
expected: All present. Create whatever is missing before starting and note it in the run log.

title: Production is not touched by this run
steps: 1. Before every write action confirm the address bar host is test.gokesari.com
expected: No order, payment, suspension, settings change or registration is made on gokesari.com. Production checks in this suite are read-only smoke checks only.

title: Production read-only smoke
steps: 1. Open https://gokesari.com/ , /shops, /search?q=milk, /signin, /legal/terms
expected: Pages load without errors. Do not sign in, order or submit any form on production.

title: The 3-Oct requirements are deployed on test
steps:
1. Open a loose product on /shop/prices and check whether a price is pre-filled
2. Open the shop category screen and check whether the owner can add a product category
3. Open a packaged listing and check whether the MRP can be edited by the owner
expected: Record for each of NEW-008, NEW-009 and NEW-010 whether the behaviour is present. Any that is missing makes its cases below Blocked (not Fail) until the build is deployed.

title: The open features treated as completed are deployed on test
steps: 1. Check on test for: SMS code at sign-in, SMS / WhatsApp / push channels, online payment at checkout, coupon field, scheduled slots, master order reference, shop KYC document upload, rider profile edit, image moderation queue, customer referral, home comparison widgets, shop-page offers, tax invoice, photo proof of delivery
expected: Record which are present. The 3-Oct open-features list shows these as not yet built; any that is missing makes its cases Blocked (not Fail) until deployed.

title: New user signs up with an unused mobile number
preconditions: Unused 10-digit mobile and unused email whose inbox can be read
steps:
1. Open /signin
2. Enter the mobile
3. Enter the email when asked
4. Enter the 6-digit code from the email
expected: Step 2 says the number is not registered yet and asks for an email. Message shows the masked email (ab***@...). Email subject is 'NNNNNN is your Gokesari sign-in code'. After the code, 'Tell us about you' opens with mobile pre-filled and email read-only.
source: Login-profile checklist: New user via mobile

title: First-time profile: details then address with geo-tag
steps:
1. Enter name and gender, Save
2. On 'Delivery address' tap 'Use my current location' (drag the pin if Maps is configured)
3. Fill the address fields, Save
expected: Lands on home. /profile shows name, gender, mobile, email and the default address with 'Geo-tagged at ...'. A wallet exists with balance 0.

title: Returning user signs in with registered mobile
steps:
1. Sign out
2. Enter the same mobile
3. Enter the code
expected: Code goes straight to the account's email, shown masked. After the code, home opens with no onboarding form.

title: New user signs up with email only
steps:
1. Enter the email on /signin
2. Enter the code
3. Save details without a mobile
4. On the address step choose 'Fill in later'
expected: Account and wallet are created. Details form shows an empty mobile field. Home opens after 'Fill in later'.
source: Login-profile checklist: New user via email

title: 'Add your mobile number' prompt for accounts without a mobile
steps:
1. Sign out and in again with the email
2. Click 'Not now'
3. Sign out and in again
4. Add a valid number in the popup
5. Sign out and in again
expected: Popup appears after each sign-in until a number is added. 'Not now' closes it. After adding a valid number it never appears again.

title: Existing pre-release account is prompted once and keeps its data
preconditions: An account created before migration 0037 with wallet balance and orders
steps: 1. Sign in (code, magic link or Google)
expected: Details form appears. Wallet balance and order history are unchanged.

title: Skip onboarding, then be asked at checkout
steps:
1. Choose 'Fill in later' on step 1
2. Top up the wallet
3. Add an item from a delivering shop and open the cart
4. Add mobile and address
5. Place the order
6. Before saving details, sign out and in again (separate run)
expected: Home and wallet work after skipping. Cart shows 'Add your mobile number...' and 'Add a delivery address...' instead of the pay button. After adding both the pay button appears and the order carries the address. Unsaved profile shows the details form again at next sign-in.
source: Login-profile checklist: Skip and fill in later

title: Google sign-in still works
steps: 1. On /signin choose Google and complete the Google flow
expected: Signed in; session persists across page loads; wallet exists.

title: Email magic-link sign-in still works
steps:
1. Request a sign-in link by email
2. Open the link
expected: Signed in. Link cannot be reused after sign-out.
source: Dev log Wave 1; QA plan section 12

title: Mobile login channel step offers SMS and email
steps: 1. Enter a registered mobile on /signin and look at the OTP destination step
expected: Email and SMS are both selectable. Choosing SMS sends the code by SMS (see the SMS cases added 4-Oct).
source: QA A-02; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: No account enumeration on unregistered number
steps:
1. POST /api/otp/request for a registered number and for an unregistered one
2. Compare status, body and timing
expected: Flow never reveals whether another person's number or email has an account beyond what the designed 'not registered - enter your email' step shows to the person typing it; error and throttle responses are identical for known and unknown values.

title: Wrong code five times locks the code
steps:
1. Request a code
2. Enter a wrong code 5 times
3. Enter the correct code
expected: Each failure: 'That code is wrong or has expired...'. After 5, the right code is refused ('Too many wrong attempts'); a new code must be requested.

title: Expired code is refused
preconditions: Default expiry 10 min (or set otp expiry to 1 min)
steps:
1. Request a code
2. Wait past expiry
3. Enter it
expected: Refused with the generic wrong/expired message.

title: Older code is superseded by a newer one
steps:
1. Request a code, wait 60 s, request another
2. Enter the first
3. Enter the second
expected: First refused, second works.

title: Used code cannot be replayed
steps:
1. Sign in with a code
2. Sign out
3. Try the same code again
expected: Refused.

title: Resend cooldown
steps:
1. Request a code
2. Click Resend immediately
3. Wait for the countdown, click Resend
expected: Resend is disabled with a countdown for 60 seconds; an immediate API call is refused with 'wait N seconds'. After the cooldown a new code arrives.

title: Hourly code limit per email / number
steps: 1. Request codes repeatedly for the same identifier (respecting cooldown)
expected: The 6th request is refused ('Too many code requests'). Unknown identifiers are throttled the same way.

title: Per-IP request limit
steps: 1. Send more than 20 OTP requests for different identifiers from one browser
expected: Requests after the limit return 429 RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSeconds.

title: Invalid mobile / email input
steps: 1. Enter each of: 12345, 5876543210, abcdefghij, +91 5xxxxxxxxx, abc@, empty
expected: Clear field-level validation message each time. No email is sent. Only Indian mobiles (10 digits starting 6-9) are accepted.

title: Mobile already linked to another account
preconditions: Two accounts; number linked to account 1
steps: 1. On account 2 add the same number from profile, from the popup and during onboarding
expected: Each refuses: 'This mobile number is already linked to another account...'.

title: Unregistered mobile + email that belongs to a different mobile
preconditions: Account X has email E and mobile M1
steps:
1. On /signin enter new mobile M2
2. Enter email E
expected: 'This email is already registered with a different mobile number...'. No account is changed.

title: Admin releases a claimed mobile number
steps:
1. Admin console -> 'Release a mobile number' -> enter M
2. On account 2 add M
expected: Release succeeds and is audited. Account 2 can now add M. Account 1 no longer shows it.

title: Edit name and gender on My Profile
steps:
1. Open /profile
2. Change name and gender
3. Save details
expected: 'Saved' confirmation. Header initial updates. Values persist after reload.

title: Change and remove mobile on My Profile
steps:
1. Change mobile to a new valid number
2. Remove it
3. Open the cart with a delivery item
expected: New number shows; after removal it shows 'Not added' and the cart asks for a mobile again. A 'Mobile number changed' security notification is sent.

title: Change email with verification on the new address
preconditions: Inbox access for old and new address
steps:
1. Start a change of email
2. Enter a wrong code
3. Enter the right code
4. Sign out and sign in with the new email
expected: Code goes to the NEW address. Wrong code: error, email unchanged. Right code: email updated and the OLD address receives a 'was changed' email. New email signs in.

title: Change email to one used by another account
steps: 1. Enter another account's email as the new email
expected: 'This email address is already used by another account.'

title: Suspended account cannot sign in
steps: 1. Try mobile, email-code and Google sign-in
expected: All refused; /signin?error=AccessDenied explains the account is suspended or closed with a link to the grievance form. No session is created.

title: OTP events are audited and codes are never exposed
steps:
1. Admin audit log: search 'auth.otp_'
2. Inspect network responses of /api/otp/request
3. (DB if available) select code_hash from login_otps
expected: Requested / verified / failed / blocked rows exist; numbers are masked; no code appears in any response, page or log. code_hash looks like salt:hex.

title: OTP limits follow /admin/settings
steps:
1. Set otp: expiry 1, attempts 2, cooldown 5
2. Repeat the wrong-code, expiry and resend cases
3. Restore default
expected: New limits apply within about 15 s; Restore default reverts them.

title: Sign out ends the session
steps:
1. Sign out
2. Use the back button to /wallet
3. GET /api/wallet
expected: Redirected to sign in; API returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED. Further log out cases: TC-AUTH-032 to TC-AUTH-045.

title: Session persists across pages and reloads
steps:
1. Sign in
2. Visit /wallet, /orders, /profile
3. Reload each
expected: Stays signed in; no repeated prompts.

title: Log out from the header menu in every role
preconditions: One account per role signed in
steps: 1. As customer, shop owner, rider, society admin, operator and admin in turn: open the account menu and choose Sign out
expected: Each role is signed out and lands on the home or sign-in page. The header shows Sign in and no name, role switcher or portal links.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Protected pages are closed after log out
steps:
1. Open /orders, /wallet, /profile, /cart
2. Open /shop, /shop/inventory, /shop/prices
3. Open the rider, society, operator and admin portals
4. Use the browser Back button to a page viewed while signed in
expected: Every page redirects to sign in. Back shows no cached personal, order, wallet or shop data.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage; extends TC-AUTH-030

title: Old session cannot be replayed after log out
preconditions: Session cookie copied before signing out
steps:
1. Sign out
2. Send GET /api/wallet and POST /api/cart with the copied cookie
expected: 401 UNAUTHENTICATED on both. The session is ended on the server, not only removed from the browser.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out in one tab ends the other tabs
preconditions: Same account open in two tabs
steps:
1. Sign out in tab 1
2. In tab 2 click a link and submit a form
expected: Tab 2 is sent to sign in on its next action. No write goes through.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out on one device and the session on another device
preconditions: Same account signed in on two browser profiles
steps:
1. Sign out on device 1
2. Reload on device 2
expected: Record the behaviour: device 2 either stays signed in (per-device sessions) or is signed out. Whichever it is must be the same every time.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Cart is kept for the user and hidden from the next user
preconditions: Customer 1 has two items in the cart
steps:
1. Customer 1 signs out
2. Customer 2 signs in on the same browser and opens the cart
3. Customer 2 signs out; Customer 1 signs in again
expected: Customer 2 sees only an own cart, never Customer 1 items. Customer 1 finds the two items again.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Next user on a shared phone sees nothing of the previous user
preconditions: Shop owner A just signed out on the browser
steps:
1. Customer 2 signs in on the same browser
2. Check header name, delivery location, saved addresses, notifications, wallet and role switcher
3. Open /shop
expected: Everything shown belongs to Customer 2. No shop portal, role or location carried over from owner A. /shop is refused.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out with unsaved changes on an edit screen
preconditions: A price field changed but not saved
steps: 1. Choose Sign out
expected: A warning is shown before the changes are lost, or the user is signed out with the old value kept. Nothing half-saved.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage; TC-UX-005

title: Rider logs out while online
preconditions: Rider 1 online with no active job
steps:
1. Sign out
2. Mark an order READY at Shop A
3. Sign in again as the rider
expected: Record the behaviour and confirm it with the owner: expected is that a logged-out rider is not offered jobs (set offline, or offers lapse). The rider must not be left online and unreachable.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out while acting in a second role
preconditions: Multi-role user switched to the Shop role
steps:
1. Sign out
2. Sign in again
expected: Sign-in works. Record which role is active on return; it must be a role the user holds.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out cannot be triggered by another site
steps: 1. From a different origin send a plain GET and a POST without the CSRF token to the sign-out address
expected: The user stays signed in. Only the real Sign out action ends the session.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out is reachable on a phone screen
steps:
1. Open the menu
2. Choose Sign out
expected: Sign out is visible without horizontal scrolling and works.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Automatic log off after the session lifetime
preconditions: Signed in; session lifetime known or shortened on test
steps:
1. Leave the browser idle past the session lifetime
2. Click a link
3. Sign in again
expected: Record the lifetime. After it passes the user is sent to sign in, then returned to the page asked for. No error page.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: Log out and log in are recorded; repeated log out is harmless
steps:
1. A customer signs out and in again
2. Double-click Sign out; open the sign-out address when already signed out
3. Admin opens the sign-in activity / audit view
expected: Sign-in and sign-out events appear with time and user. Repeated or duplicate sign-out shows the home page, never an error.
source: Request 3-Oct: log out / log off coverage

title: New mobile sign-up receives the code by SMS
preconditions: Unused Indian mobile that can receive SMS
steps:
1. Enter the mobile on /signin
2. Choose SMS
3. Enter the code from the SMS
expected: SMS arrives within a minute with the code. Sign-in succeeds, onboarding opens and the mobile is marked verified.

title: Returning user chooses SMS or email for the code
steps:
1. Enter the mobile
2. Choose SMS and sign in
3. Sign out and repeat choosing email
expected: Both channels are selectable and work. The destination is shown masked.

title: Wrong, expired and superseded SMS codes
steps:
1. Enter a wrong code 5 times
2. Request a new code and wait past its validity
3. Request two codes and enter the first
expected: Five wrong attempts lock the code. Expired and older codes are refused. Limits are the same as for email codes (/admin/settings).

title: SMS resend cooldown and hourly limit
steps:
1. Tap Resend before the cooldown ends
2. Request codes until the hourly limit is passed
expected: Resend is disabled during the cooldown. Requests past the hourly limit are refused and no SMS is sent (no SMS cost run-up).

title: No SMS to invalid numbers and no account enumeration
steps:
1. Enter 5876543210, a 9-digit number and a non-Indian number
2. Enter a valid number with no account and one with an account; compare responses
expected: No SMS is sent for invalid numbers. The responses for registered and unregistered numbers do not reveal which exists.

title: SMS provider failure during sign-in
preconditions: SMS provider switched off or failing on test
steps: 1. Request a code by SMS
expected: The user is told the SMS could not be sent and is offered email. The failure is recorded; nothing claims an SMS was sent.

title: SMS content and code secrecy
steps:
1. Read the SMS text and sender
2. Check the audit log and stored records for the code
expected: SMS uses the registered sender and template and carries only the code and validity. The code is never visible in the audit log, API responses or stored in plain text.

title: Mobile change is proven by an SMS code to the new number
steps:
1. On My Profile enter a new mobile
2. Enter a wrong code, then the right one
expected: Code goes to the NEW number. Wrong code: mobile unchanged. Right code: mobile updated and marked verified.

title: A mobile cannot be taken over without its SMS code
preconditions: Mobile X belongs to another account
steps:
1. Try to add mobile X to this account
2. Send the change through the API without a code
expected: Refused both ways. The other account is unaffected.

title: Guest can browse and search without signing in
steps: 1. Open /, /shops, /search, a shop page and a product comparison page
expected: All readable. Add to cart / subscribe prompts sign-in.

title: Guest is blocked from every signed-in area
steps:
1. Open /wallet, /orders, /cart, /profile, /subscriptions, /shop, /delivery-partner, /society, /admin, /operator
2. GET /api/wallet, /api/orders, /api/cart, /api/notifications
expected: Pages redirect to sign-in. APIs return 401.

title: Customer cannot reach shop, rider, society, operator or admin portals
steps:
1. Open /admin and every /admin/* page from the preflight list, /operator, /shop/orders, /shop/finance, /shop/marketing, /shop/analytics, /delivery-partner, /gig/orders, /society/{id}
2. Call one write API from each area
expected: Each page redirects away (home or the apply/register page). APIs return 403 FORBIDDEN.

title: Shop owner limited to own shop
preconditions: Shop owner A; Shop B belongs to another owner
steps:
1. As A: open /shop pages
2. PATCH /api/shops/{B}, POST /api/shops/{B}/products, PATCH a shop-product of B, GET /api/shops/{B}/inventory, POST /api/excel-uploads for B
expected: Own shop works. Every call against B returns 403/404 and changes nothing.

title: Shop owner cannot open admin or other roles' portals
steps: 1. Open /admin/*, /delivery-partner (without rider role), /society/{id} of a society they do not manage
expected: Redirected / 403.

title: Rider limited to own jobs and availability
expected: Own dashboard works. Other riders' deliveries and profiles: 403/404.

title: Operator can verify shops but not admin-only functions
steps:
1. Open /admin
2. Approve/reject a shop
3. Try /admin/settings, finance approve/pay, POST /api/users/{id}/suspend, PATCH /api/users/{id}/role, /admin/rider-earnings rules
expected: Shop verification works. /admin/settings redirects. Finance approve/pay, user suspend and role changes return 403. Audit log shows the limited view only.
source: QA S-01; Dev log Slice 6 K; RBAC Matrix

title: Operator 'Limited' shop management - record current behaviour
steps: 1. As OPERATOR try PATCH /api/shops/{id} (name, hours, radius) and shop product edits
expected: Record exactly what an operator can and cannot change today. This is evidence for the pending decision, not a pass/fail.

title: Admin sets a user's role
expected: Role saved with a Save confirmation; audited; a role-change security notification is sent. User now sees the operator console.

title: Admin privilege change needs confirmation and is audited
steps:
1. Open /admin/users/{id}/privileges
2. Change a privilege
3. Try to leave without saving
4. Save
expected: Save button enabled only after a change; unsaved-changes warning on leaving; confirmation before saving; success message; audit row with old and new values.

title: User holds several roles and switches between them
preconditions: Shop owner applies as a rider and is approved
steps:
1. Check the header role switcher
2. Switch SHOP_OWNER -> DELIVERY_PARTNER -> CUSTOMER
3. GET /api/me/roles
expected: Both roles are held; switching changes the portal and navigation. Active role is reflected by the API.

title: Cannot switch to a role not held
steps: 1. PUT /api/me/roles {role:'ADMIN'} and {role:'OPERATOR'}
expected: 403/422; active role unchanged.

title: Revoking the active role falls back to CUSTOMER
steps:
1. Admin: DELETE /api/users/{id}/roles?role=OPERATOR
2. User reloads
expected: User becomes CUSTOMER immediately and loses console access.

title: Staff roles are exclusive
steps: 1. Grant OPERATOR then ADMIN
expected: Staff roles replace each other rather than stack; behaviour matches 'staff roles exclusive'. Record the exact result.

title: Existing users kept access after migration backfill
steps: 1. Sign in as a pre-existing shop owner, rider and operator
expected: Each still reaches their portal; each has a grant for the role.

title: Every role can place a personal order
steps: 1. As SHOP_OWNER (and separately as rider, operator) add items from another shop and check out as PERSONAL
expected: Order placed normally.

title: B2B order by a shop owner
steps: 1. Check out with orderType B2B and buyerShopId = own shop, cart from another shop
expected: Order created with order_type B2B. Mobile/address rules for personal orders do not apply.

title: B2B refused for a customer, for another owner's shop and for own-shop items
steps:
1. POST /api/checkout B2B as CUSTOMER
2. As owner with buyerShopId of another shop
3. As owner with cart items from the same shop
4. PERSONAL with buyerShopId set
expected: 403 / 422 each time; nothing created or debited.

title: Order visibility is role-scoped
preconditions: Orders exist for two customers and two shops
steps:
1. Customer: /orders and GET /api/orders
2. Shop: /shop/orders
3. Rider: deliveries
4. Society admin: dashboard deliveries
5. Operator: /admin/orders
6. Admin: /admin/orders
expected: Customer sees own only; shop sees own shop only; rider own jobs; society sees society deliveries with no customer PII or order contents; operator and admin see all shops.
source: RBAC Matrix: View all orders; Status report RBAC-010

title: Settlement visibility per role
steps:
1. Shop: /shop/finance
2. Rider: earnings and payouts
3. Operator: /admin/finance and /admin/finance/exceptions
4. Customer: /shop/finance, /api/finance/summary
expected: Shop and rider see only their own statements. Operator sees exceptions only, with no settlement or payout totals. Customer is refused.

title: Audit log viewer: admin full, operator limited
steps: 1. Open the audit section as ADMIN then as OPERATOR
expected: Admin sees all actions with actor, role, old/new values. Operator sees the limited subset. Customer/shop cannot open it.

title: Audit log is append-only
preconditions: DB access to the TEST database only
steps: 1. Attempt UPDATE and DELETE on one audit_logs row
expected: Both are refused by the database trigger.

title: IDOR sweep on customer-owned resources
preconditions: Customer 2's address, order, subscription, return and notification ids
steps: 1. As Customer 1 call GET/PATCH/DELETE on /api/addresses/{id}, /api/orders/{id}/status, /api/orders/{id}/rating, /api/orders/{id}/issue, /api/subscriptions/{id} (+pause/skip/calendar/history), /api/returns/{id}, /api/tracking/{orderId}
expected: Every call returns 403 or 404; nothing changes; no data of Customer 2 is returned.
source: Test plan section 3 (IDOR); Dev log Phase 2 fix

title: Suspended user loses the session on the next request
preconditions: Customer signed in on a second browser/profile
steps:
1. Admin suspends the customer
2. Customer loads any page
expected: Customer is signed out on the next request and cannot sign in again.

title: Set delivery location by PIN code
steps: 1. Home -> 'Deliver to' -> Change -> enter a valid 6-digit PIN
expected: Label updates. 'Shops that deliver to you' refreshes. Choice persists across pages and reloads (gk_location cookie).
source: Dev log Slice 1 handoff; QA B-03

title: Invalid PIN is rejected
expected: Field error; location unchanged; POST /api/location returns 422.

title: Set location from device position - allow and deny
steps:
1. Choose 'Use my current location' and allow
2. Repeat and deny the browser prompt
expected: Allow: location set (coordinates rounded to 4 decimals). Deny: a clear message and the previous location is kept.

title: Set location from a saved address
steps: 1. Pick each saved address in the location picker
expected: List of delivering shops changes accordingly; the cart preselects that address.

title: Signed-in customer defaults to the default address
preconditions: Default address set; no location cookie
steps:
1. Clear the location
2. Reload home
expected: Discovery uses the default address.

title: Search an address with Places and save it
steps:
1. Change -> 'Search an address' -> pick a result
2. Accept the offer to save it
expected: Location label updates; shop list refreshes; the place is saved as an address.

title: Clear location
steps: 1. Clear the location (DELETE /api/location)
expected: Cookie cleared; pages show all shops or ask for a location.

title: Address book: create, edit, set default, delete
steps:
1. /profile/addresses -> add with type Home/Work/Other, recipient name and mobile, landmark, PIN, map pin
2. Edit
3. Set default
4. Delete a non-default address
expected: All fields persist and display. Default flag moves. Deleted address disappears and is no longer selectable in the cart.

title: Invalid recipient mobile on an address
steps: 1. Save an address with recipient mobile 12345
expected: Rejected with a field message.

title: Re-pin an address on the map
steps: 1. Edit an address and move the pin / use current location
expected: New coordinates saved; 'Geo-tagged at' updates.

title: Shop sets delivery radius
steps:
1. /shop -> Location card -> set radius 2 km, save
2. Set 50
3. Set 1
expected: Saved each time; audit entry records the previous value.

title: Radius boundaries rejected
expected: Each rejected (422); stored value unchanged.

title: Customer outside the radius does not see the shop
preconditions: Shop radius 2 km; customer address about 5 km away
steps:
1. Set location to that address
2. Open home, /shops and /search
expected: Shop absent from 'Shops that deliver to you' and from filtered lists.

title: Customer exactly at / just inside / just outside the radius
preconditions: Addresses at about 1.9, 2.0 and 2.1 km (straight line)
steps: 1. Check shop visibility for each
expected: Inside and at the radius: listed. Outside: not listed. Distance shown matches straight-line distance.

title: Extra delivery PIN zone beyond the radius
steps:
1. Shop adds the customer's PIN to extra delivery zones
2. Customer reloads
expected: Shop now appears for that PIN and checkout is allowed.

title: Shop without coordinates matches by PIN only
preconditions: A shop with no pinned location
steps: 1. Set location to the same PIN, then a different PIN
expected: Listed only when the PIN matches exactly.

title: Shop with delivery off or not approved is never listed as delivering
preconditions: One shop delivery off; one PENDING; one SUSPENDED
steps: 1. Browse with a location set
expected: None appears in delivering lists. Pending/suspended shops do not appear at all, including with ?all=1.

title: Cart warns when a shop does not deliver to the address
preconditions: Cart has items from an out-of-zone shop
steps: 1. Open /cart
expected: That shop's group shows 'does not deliver' with a 'Change address' action; pay button disabled.

title: Checkout hard block via API
steps: 1. POST /api/checkout with the out-of-zone addressId
expected: Validation error naming the shop; no order, no debit, no stock change.

title: Cart re-validates when the address changes
steps: 1. Switch the address in the cart dropdown
expected: Issues, delivery fee and eligibility update without a page reload.

title: Mixed cart: only the affected shop is flagged
preconditions: Cart with items from two shops; one cannot deliver
steps:
1. Open cart
2. Click 'Remove these items' on the flagged group
expected: Only that shop's lines are removed; the other shop's lines remain and checkout becomes available.

title: Minimum order value
steps:
1. Cart Rs 100 -> open cart
2. Call checkout API directly
3. Raise the cart to exactly Rs 200
4. Pickup order (no address) with Rs 100
expected: Below: 'needs a minimum order ... add Rs 100 more' with 'Add items', pay disabled, API validation error. Exactly Rs 200: allowed. Pickup orders are exempt.

title: Pause new orders
steps:
1. Shop ticks 'Pause new orders'
2. Customer checks lists and cart
3. Shop un-pauses
expected: Shop leaves delivery lists; cart shows 'not taking new orders' with 'Remove these items'; checkout refuses. Un-pause restores everything.

title: Ordering from a closed shop needs confirmation
preconditions: Shop currently outside its opening hours (IST)
steps:
1. Add items, open cart
2. Click pay, answer No
3. Click pay, answer Yes
4. Call checkout API without acknowledgeClosedShopIds
expected: Cart shows 'might be closed ... opens <day time>'. No keeps the cart. Yes places the order. API without acknowledgement returns 409.

title: Closed-shop alerts are sent once
preconditions: Order placed while closed; notifications cron running
steps:
1. Check shop and customer notifications immediately
2. Check again just after the shop's opening time
expected: Immediately: shop gets 'order while closed' (in-app + email) and customer gets 'queued'. On opening: one 'orders waiting' to the shop and one 'shop now open' to the customer - never duplicated.

title: Opening-hours edge cases use IST
steps: 1. Check a shop with no hours set, a shop closed on Sunday, and one whose hours cross midnight, at times either side of the boundary
expected: No hours = always open. Closed days and midnight boundaries are judged in IST regardless of the browser's timezone. No hydration error on the shop grid.

title: Link an address to a society
preconditions: Customer is an approved member of a VERIFIED society
steps:
1. Link an address to that society
2. Place an order to it
expected: Link saved; the order carries the society (visible on the society dashboard deliveries).

title: Cannot link an address to a society you do not belong to
steps: 1. PUT /api/addresses/{id}/society with an unverified society, and with a verified society the user is not an active member of
expected: Refused; no link.

title: Road distance and routed ETA
steps:
1. Check the delivery estimate at checkout
2. Rider opens the job
expected: ETA comes from the road route and is the same for customer and rider within rounding.

title: In-app navigation for the rider
steps:
1. Start navigation to the shop, then to the customer
2. Leave the route
expected: Route is drawn in the app and recalculated after leaving it. The customer address appears only after pickup.

title: Routing service unavailable or over quota
steps:
1. Go to checkout
2. Rider opens a job
expected: Checkout still works with a straight-line estimate marked approximate. Rider gets the Google Maps link. No 500.

title: Serviceability rule stays consistent with routing on
preconditions: Address inside the radius but far by road
steps: 1. Check whether the shop is listed and orderable
expected: Record which distance decides serviceability; list, cart and checkout must all use the same one.

title: Home page content
steps: 1. Open home with a location set
expected: Location bar, product-search-first hero, 'Shops that deliver to you', featured / Kesari / Green shelves. No duplicate shop cards.
source: Status report NAV-001; earlier session noted a duplicated Featured shop

title: Shop list is filtered to the location and sorted nearest first
preconditions: Three delivering shops at different distances
steps: 1. Open /shops
expected: Only delivering shops, nearest first, each with a distance.

title: 'Show all shops' toggle keeps other filters
steps:
1. On /shops apply a type filter
2. Toggle 'Show all shops' (?all=1)
expected: All approved shops of that type shown; the filter is preserved.

title: Shop search by name, category, area and PIN
steps: 1. Search by a shop name, a partial name, a shop type, an area and a PIN
expected: Matching approved shops returned for each. Empty result shows a helpful empty state.

title: Shop filters: type, classification, delivery
steps: 1. Filter by DAIRY/BAKERY/other type, KESARI/GREEN, delivery only
expected: Results honour each filter and combinations.

title: Product search limited to serviceable shops
preconditions: Product sold by an in-zone and an out-of-zone shop
steps: 1. Search the product name
expected: Only in-zone offers listed, nearest first, distance on each card; 'Compare prices' link present.

title: Search edge cases
steps: 1. Search: empty string, one character, a very long string, special characters (<script>, %, '), a product that does not exist
expected: No error page; empty state for no results; input is displayed escaped (no script runs).

title: Product page lists every shop selling the product
preconditions: Master product sold by Shop A and Shop B
steps: 1. Open /products/{id} from a 'Compare prices' link
expected: Both shops listed with price, distance and delivers-to-you status.

title: Local price comparison ordering and badge
preconditions: Shop A Rs 70, Shop B Rs 66 for the same pack
steps: 1. Open the comparison page
expected: Sort: deliverable+buyable first, then price, then distance. Shop B carries the 'Lowest price' badge.

title: Per-unit and per-pack price normalisation
preconditions: Same product in 500 ml and 1 L packs
steps: 1. Open the comparison page
expected: Per-unit price is shown alongside pack price so different pack sizes compare fairly.

title: Out-of-stock and in-shop-only rows
preconditions: One shop out of stock; one offline-only
steps: 1. Open the comparison page
expected: Rows are shown but clearly marked and not buyable; they sort after buyable rows. Rows with no price set behave the same (TC-CAT-034).

title: Bad product id
steps: 1. Open /products/not-a-uuid and /products/{random uuid}
expected: 404 page, not a 500.

title: Shop page content
steps: 1. Open /shops/{slug}
expected: Shop profile, catalogue, rating with recent reviews, opening hours with closed-now state, delivery options (fee, free-above threshold, pickup-only, minimum order).

title: Offline-only product is visible but not buyable
steps: 1. Open the shop page
expected: Product shows 'In-shop only' with a disabled control and no 'Add to cart'.

title: External reference prices shown by default
preconditions: A verified reference exists; rule showToCustomers = true (default)
steps: 1. Open the product page
expected: The 'Reference prices' block is shown. MRP and shop prices are shown separately.
source: QA I-02; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Reference prices hidden when the rule is off
steps:
1. Set externalPrices.showToCustomers false
2. Open the product page
3. Restore default
expected: No 'Reference prices' block while the rule is off.
source: QA I-03; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Category and department pages
steps: 1. Open /categories, /category/{type}, /dairy, /bakery
expected: Pages list the right shops/products; links work.

title: Product without an image shows a neutral placeholder
steps: 1. Find a product with no image and one with a broken URL
expected: Neutral placeholder; never a broken-image icon.

title: Reference prices are shown to customers
preconditions: Verified, recent reference for a product
steps: 1. Open the product page
expected: A 'Reference prices' block shows source, price and time with a note that it is neither the MRP nor a shop price.

title: Unverified, rejected or stale references are hidden
preconditions: Product with only unverified / rejected / old references; another with none
steps: 1. Open both product pages
expected: No reference block. No reference ever changes a shop price or MRP.

title: Home page price-comparison widgets
preconditions: Location set; a product sold by two delivering shops
steps: 1. Open the home page
expected: Widgets show products with the lowest local price and the shop, and link to the comparison page. Prices match the product page.

title: Home widgets with no location, no shops or unpriced products
steps:
1. Open home with no location
2. Set a PIN with no delivering shop
3. Include a product that only has unpriced listings
expected: A prompt to set the location, then a clear empty state. Unpriced, out-of-stock and non-delivering listings never appear as an offer.

title: Offers on the shop page
preconditions: Shop A has an active offer
steps:
1. Open the Shop A page
2. Use the offer at checkout
expected: Active offers are listed with terms and expiry and apply at checkout.

title: Expired, paused and other-shop offers
steps: 1. Open a shop whose offer expired, one with a paused offer and one with none
expected: None of these is shown. No empty offers box.

title: Add to cart from a single shop
steps:
1. Add two products from Shop A
2. Open /cart
expected: Lines grouped under Shop A with live prices, quantities, per-shop delivery fee and total.

title: Change quantity and remove a line
steps:
1. Increase and decrease quantity
2. Remove a line
3. Clear the cart
expected: Totals recompute each time; removed lines disappear; empty cart shows an empty state.

title: Cannot add more than the stock
steps:
1. Add 3 then try to add 1 more
2. POST /api/cart with quantity 99
expected: Refused with OUT_OF_STOCK; the check is against the total resulting quantity.

title: Invalid quantities
steps: 1. POST /api/cart with quantity 0, -1, 1.5, a string, and a random shopProductId
expected: 422 / 404; cart unchanged.

title: Multi-shop cart groups by shop
steps: 1. Add items from Shop A and Shop B
expected: Two groups, each with its own delivery fee and subtotal; grand total is the sum.

title: Cart shows the live price after the shop changes it
steps:
1. Shop owner changes the online price
2. Customer reloads the cart and checks out
expected: Cart shows the new price; the order is charged at the server-recomputed price.

title: Line becomes unavailable while in the cart
steps:
1. Shop disables online sale (or stock goes to 0)
2. Customer reloads the cart Also: the owner clears the price of a loose product (TC-CAT-035).
expected: Line flagged not purchasable with a reason; pay disabled until it is removed.

title: Delivery window choices and feasibility
steps:
1. At checkout view Express 30 / Standard 60 / Scheduled
2. GET /api/checkout/delivery-windows
expected: Only windows the system can back are offered, each with an estimated-minutes figure. Record what is shown when no rider is online.

title: Wallet checkout - single shop
preconditions: Wallet >= total; mobile and address on the account
steps: 1. Pay from the cart
expected: One order created as CONFIRMED; wallet debited by exactly the total; stock reduced; order appears on /orders; cart emptied; shop notified.

title: Wallet checkout - multi-shop split
steps: 1. Pay
expected: Two independent orders, one per shop, one wallet debit each, each with its own delivery fee. (No master order yet - record the customer-facing references.)

title: Insufficient wallet balance
steps: 1. Pay
expected: 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE with the shortfall shown and a top-up prompt. No order, no debit, no stock consumed.

title: Idempotent checkout
steps:
1. Double-click pay
2. Re-send POST /api/checkout with the same requestId
expected: Exactly one set of orders and one debit; the replay returns the original orders with deduplicated: true.

title: Stock race between two customers
preconditions: Stock 1; two customers with it in their carts
steps: 1. Both pay as close together as possible
expected: One succeeds; the other gets OUT_OF_STOCK with no debit.

title: Checkout rate limit
steps: 1. Send more than 15 checkout requests in a minute
expected: 429 RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSeconds after the 15th.

title: Order needs a mobile number and, for delivery, an address
steps:
1. Open cart
2. POST /api/checkout directly
expected: Cart shows prompts instead of pay. API refuses. Pickup-only shops need no address; B2B is unchanged.

title: Pickup order from a shop that does not deliver
steps: 1. Order without an address
expected: Order placed; no delivery fee; no rider dispatch at READY; shop completes READY -> DELIVERED itself.

title: Order notes and delivery instructions carried through
steps:
1. Add order notes and an address landmark
2. Place the order
expected: Notes visible to the shop; landmark/instructions visible to the rider only on the active job after pickup.

title: Order summary and history after checkout
steps: 1. Open /orders
expected: Order card shows number, shop, items, amount, status 'confirmed' and available actions (cancel, report a problem).

title: Coupon field is offered at checkout
steps: 1. Look for a coupon field in cart/checkout
expected: A coupon field is present and works (see the coupon cases added 4-Oct). Vouchers still apply to wallet top-ups.
source: Status report NAV-003; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Scheduled delivery slot with real times
steps: 1. Choose a scheduled slot for tomorrow and pay
expected: The order carries the slot; shop and rider see it; dispatch is timed for it.

title: Slot capacity
preconditions: A slot with capacity 1 on test
steps:
1. Customer 1 books the slot
2. Customer 2 opens checkout
3. Two customers pay for the last place at the same moment
expected: A full slot is shown as full and cannot be chosen. In the race exactly one gets it; the other is asked to pick again with no charge.

title: Invalid slots are refused
steps: 1. POST checkout with a past slot, a slot outside shop hours, a full slot and a made-up slot id
expected: Each refused with a reason; no order.

title: Cancellation frees the slot
steps: 1. Cancel the order holding it
expected: The slot becomes available again.

title: Master order links the per-shop orders
preconditions: Cart from Shop A and Shop B
steps:
1. Check out
2. Open /orders
expected: One master reference for the purchase with both shop orders under it, each with its own status and tracking.

title: One shop fails or is cancelled under a master order
steps:
1. Check out when Shop B has just gone out of stock
2. In a completed purchase let Shop B reject its order
expected: At checkout the customer is told which shop failed before any charge. After a rejection only that part is refunded and the master shows partly cancelled.

title: Master order visibility
steps:
1. As Shop A request the master order and the Shop B child
2. As another customer request the master order
expected: Shop A sees only its own child order. Others get 403 / 404.

title: Apply an order-level coupon
steps:
1. Enter the coupon on a Rs 300 cart
2. Pay
expected: Discount Rs 30 shown before payment; total and charge reduced; coupon recorded on the order and its use counted.

title: Invalid coupons
steps: 1. Enter an unknown code, an expired code, one whose minimum is not met, one already used up by this user, and one for another shop
expected: Each refused with its own clear reason; total unchanged.

title: Coupon limits and settlement
steps:
1. Apply a coupon larger than the cart
2. Send two coupons through the API
3. Cancel a couponed order and reuse the coupon
4. Open the shop settlement for a couponed order
expected: Total never below zero. One coupon per order. Cancelling restores the use. The settlement shows who bears the discount (shop or platform).

title: Refund on a couponed order
steps:
1. Shop removes one line
2. Cancel the rest
expected: Refunds are in proportion to what was paid; the customer never gets back more than was charged.

title: Wallet page
steps: 1. Open /wallet
expected: Balance, today's deductions, low-balance state, 15-day subscription forecast and recent transactions.

title: Top up the wallet (mock / Cashfree sandbox)
preconditions: Test site in mock or sandbox mode - never pay real money
steps: 1. Choose a preset (e.g. Rs 5,000) and complete the payment
expected: 'added to your wallet' confirmation; balance rises by exactly the amount; a transaction row appears.

title: Top-up amount limits
steps: 1. POST /api/wallet/topup with 0, 99 paise, 100 paise, 1,00,000 rupees, 1,00,001 rupees, a negative and a decimal
expected: Min Rs 1 and max Rs 1,00,000 accepted; everything else 422.

title: Verify cannot be forged
steps:
1. POST /api/wallet/verify with a made-up gatewayOrderId
2. With another user's gatewayOrderId
3. Replay a real one
expected: Unpaid/unknown: FAILED and nothing credited (400 PAYMENT_VERIFICATION_FAILED). Another user's: refused. Replay: alreadyProcessed true, no second credit.

title: Cashfree webhook rejects a bad signature
steps: 1. POST /api/webhooks/cashfree with no signature and with a wrong signature
expected: Rejected; no payment state changes.

title: Failed / abandoned top-up
steps: 1. Start a top-up and cancel at the gateway
expected: Payment recorded as FAILED or PENDING; nothing credited; the customer can retry.

title: Orders can be paid by wallet, COD or online
steps: 1. Inspect payment options at checkout
expected: Wallet, Cash on delivery (where eligible) and Online (UPI / card / netbanking) are offered. No dead option.
source: Status report GS-028; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Payment rate limit
steps: 1. More than 10 top-up create/verify calls in a minute
expected: 429 after the 10th.

title: Wallet settings: low-balance threshold and auto-recharge
steps:
1. Set a low-balance threshold
2. Enable auto-recharge without trigger/amount
3. Enable with both
expected: Threshold saved and low-balance state reflects it. Auto-recharge without both values is refused; with both it saves. (Record whether any recharge is actually attempted - it is a placeholder.)

title: Wallet balance can never go negative
preconditions: Balance Rs 100; two orders of Rs 80 in two tabs
steps: 1. Pay both as close together as possible
expected: One succeeds, one gets INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE; balance ends at Rs 20.

title: Low-balance warning for subscriptions
preconditions: Active subscription; balance below the forecast
steps: 1. Open /wallet
expected: Low-balance warning with forecast; only one notification for the same condition.

title: Voucher bonus on top-up - code
steps:
1. Preview the voucher on the wallet page
2. Top up with the code
expected: Preview shows the bonus. Bonus credited as promotional balance; a redemption row is recorded.

title: Voucher rules: expired, budget exhausted, per-user limit, minimum amount
steps: 1. Try each
expected: Each refused with a specific message; top-up itself still works without the bonus.

title: Admin voucher management and bulk upload
steps:
1. Create a voucher
2. Change status
3. Download the template and upload a sheet with one valid and one invalid row
4. Apply
expected: Voucher created/paused. Upload previews row statuses, rejects the bad row and applies the good one. Dashboard and redemptions update.

title: Promotional balance survives a refund correctly
preconditions: Order paid partly from promotional credit
steps: 1. Cancel the order
expected: Refund restores the promotional and customer-funded parts separately.

title: Dev top-up endpoint is not usable
steps: 1. POST /api/dev/settle-topup on test and (read-only check) confirm it is not available on production
expected: Refused outside development. Record the status code on both hosts.

title: Pay for an order by UPI
preconditions: Cashfree sandbox; cart from Shop A
steps:
1. Choose Online at checkout
2. Complete a successful UPI payment in the hosted checkout
expected: Returned to the order page. Order CONFIRMED with payment method ONLINE; wallet untouched; stock reduced; shop alerted.

title: Pay for an order by card and by netbanking
steps:
1. Pay one order by card
2. Pay another by netbanking
expected: Both orders CONFIRMED and paid.

title: Payment declined
steps: 1. Pay with a sandbox instrument that fails
expected: Clear failure message. Order is not confirmed, stock is released, the cart is kept and the customer can retry or choose another method.

title: Hosted checkout abandoned
steps:
1. Start an online payment and close the tab
2. Return to the site
3. Wait for the pending payment to expire
expected: No confirmed order and no charge. The pending payment expires, stock is released and the cart is still there.

title: Order cannot be confirmed by a forged or altered payment
steps:
1. Call the verify / return address with a made-up payment id
2. Replay the return of an earlier paid order
3. Change the amount in the browser before paying
expected: Each refused. The server verifies status and amount with the gateway; an amount mismatch never confirms the order.

title: Order-payment webhook: bad signature and duplicates
steps:
1. POST a webhook with a wrong signature
2. Send the same valid webhook twice
expected: Bad signature rejected. The duplicate is acknowledged and changes nothing (one order, one payment).

title: Webhook confirms the order when the browser never returns
steps: 1. Pay successfully, then close the browser before the redirect
expected: The order is confirmed by the webhook and appears on /orders with a notification.

title: Same order paid twice from two tabs
steps:
1. Open checkout in two tabs
2. Pay in both
expected: One order and one captured payment. The second attempt is blocked, or captured and refunded automatically.

title: Multi-shop cart paid online once
preconditions: Cart from Shop A and Shop B
steps: 1. Pay online
expected: One payment for the full amount; one order per shop under one master reference; each shop sees only its part.

title: Payment states through the lifecycle
steps: 1. Open the payment in the admin money trace through authorisation, capture and reconciliation
expected: States move CREATED -> AUTHORIZED -> CAPTURED -> RECONCILED with time stamps. Wallet and COD orders are unaffected.

title: Illegal payment transitions are refused
steps: 1. Try FAILED -> CAPTURED, REFUNDED -> CAPTURED and RECONCILED -> CREATED through the API
expected: Each refused; the state is unchanged.

title: Full refund to the original payment method
steps: 1. Cancel the order before the shop accepts
expected: Full refund is sent to the source instrument (not the wallet), shown with a reference and expected time. Stock restored.

title: Partial refund to source
steps:
1. Shop removes one line
2. Later a cheaper substitute is approved on another order
3. A return is approved on a delivered order
expected: Each difference is refunded to the source for the exact amount. Order totals and refund history agree.

title: Over-refund, refund replay and gateway refund failure
steps:
1. Refund more than was captured
2. Repeat a refund request with the same key
3. Make the gateway refund fail on test
expected: Over-refund refused. Replay returns the first result with no second refund. A failed gateway refund is retried and raised as a finance exception, never shown as done.

title: Chargeback
steps: 1. Receive a chargeback for a delivered order
expected: Payment moves to CHARGEBACK; the order is flagged; a finance exception is opened; the shop settlement for it is held.

title: Reconciliation of online order payments
steps:
1. Run reconciliation for a day with online orders
2. Introduce one mismatch on test
expected: Matched payments become RECONCILED. The mismatch is listed as an exception with both amounts.

title: Amount limits for online payment
steps:
1. Pay the smallest order the shop allows
2. Try an order above the gateway maximum
expected: Within limits works. Above the maximum the customer is told before payment starts.

title: No card or UPI details are held by GoKesari
steps: 1. Inspect API responses, logs and stored payment records after a card payment
expected: Only gateway references and masked details are present. No card number, CVV or UPI PIN anywhere.

title: Payment is not started for an order that cannot be placed
steps: 1. Go to pay online with: an out-of-zone address, an out-of-stock line, a suspended shop, a paused shop, a total under the minimum order
expected: Each is stopped before the gateway opens, with the reason. No charge.

title: Shop opts in to COD
steps: 1. /shop/marketing (COD setting) -> enable
expected: Saved; COD becomes available to eligible customers of this shop.

title: COD order placed and confirmed unpaid
preconditions: Shop opted in; order <= Rs 2,000; saved address
steps: 1. Choose Cash on delivery and place the order
expected: Order CONFIRMED with payment method COD; wallet not debited; stock reduced.

title: COD eligibility refusals
steps:
1. Try COD: for a B2B order
2. without an address
3. from a shop not opted in
4. total Rs 2,000.01+
5. as a 3rd open COD order
6. GET /api/cod/eligibility in each case
expected: Each refused with the reason; eligibility endpoint explains why not. Exactly Rs 2,000 is allowed.

title: COD paused after failed COD deliveries or a HIGH risk flag
preconditions: Customer with 2 failed COD deliveries in 90 days, or an open HIGH flag
steps: 1. Try COD
expected: Refused with the reason.

title: Cancel a COD order before delivery
steps: 1. Cancel
expected: No wallet refund (nothing was paid); stock restored.

title: Rider must confirm cash to complete a COD delivery
steps:
1. Try deliver with OTP but without cashCollected
2. Deliver with OTP and cash confirmed
expected: First refused. Second: DELIVERED, order becomes paid, a COD_CASH_COLLECTED adjustment (-total) is recorded against the rider.

title: Operator override on COD needs cashCollected
steps:
1. POST confirm-delivery with proofNote only
2. With cashCollected true
expected: First refused; second completes and is audited.

title: Shop self-delivery collects as SHOP
steps: 1. Shop marks delivered with cash
expected: Cash is held against the shop, not a rider.

title: Record a cash deposit
steps:
1. /admin/cod -> record a deposit <= held with a reference
2. Try a deposit > held
3. Re-submit the same requestId
expected: Deposit recorded (+); held amount falls. Over-deposit refused. Replay does not double-count.

title: Held cash is netted in the next payout / settlement
preconditions: Rider with held cash and earnings
steps: 1. Prepare the weekly payout
expected: Net = earnings - cash still held. A negative batch is possible and is flagged for manual collection.

title: Refund of a delivered COD order
steps: 1. Refund the order
expected: Refund is a wallet credit; reconciliation treats collected cash as the payment.

title: COD checkout replay
steps: 1. Re-send the COD checkout with the same requestId
expected: Same orders returned; no duplicates.

title: Happy-path status sequence with history
steps:
1. Drive one order CONFIRMED -> ACCEPTED -> PREPARING -> READY -> ASSIGNED -> PICKED_UP -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> DELIVERED
2. Check the customer's order view after each step
expected: Each status appears in order with a timestamp; the customer sees the matching label; a history row and audit entry exist per change.
source: Dev log Slices 3-4 handoff; State Machines sheet

title: Illegal transitions are refused
steps: 1. PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status: CONFIRMED -> DELIVERED, DELIVERED -> PREPARING, CANCELLED -> PREPARING, READY -> ACCEPTED, and an unknown status
expected: 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION (422 for the unknown value); order unchanged.

title: Unpaid order cannot be confirmed by hand
preconditions: An order in PENDING / PAYMENT_FAILED / WALLET_INSUFFICIENT
steps: 1. Try to set CONFIRMED or PREPARING
expected: Refused.

title: DISPUTED is operations-only
steps:
1. Shop sets DISPUTED
2. Operator sets DISPUTED
expected: Shop refused; operator succeeds; a disputed order is excluded from settlement.

title: RETURNED only after a failed delivery
steps: 1. Set RETURNED on a READY order, then on a FAILED order
expected: First refused; second allowed, leading to cancel and refund.

title: Customer cancels a CONFIRMED order
steps: 1. Cancel before the shop accepts
expected: Full refund (goods + delivery fee) to the wallet; stock returned; status CANCELLED; shop notified.

title: Customer cannot cancel while ACCEPTED / PREPARING / READY / ASSIGNED
steps: 1. Try to cancel at each of the four stages
expected: Blocked: 'already being prepared - contact the shop'. No refund.

title: Customer cancels after pickup
steps: 1. Cancel
expected: Goods-only refund; delivery fee kept; rider still paid; assignment cancelled; ledger shows a DELIVERY_FEE credit for the platform.

title: Customer cannot self-cancel FAILED / RETURNED / DISPUTED / DELIVERED
steps: 1. Try to cancel in each state
expected: Refused; directed to support.

title: Shop or operator cancels at each stage
steps: 1. Cancel orders at CONFIRMED, ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY, ASSIGNED and after pickup
expected: Full refund every time; stock returned; rider paid only if goods had been picked up.

title: Cancel after a partial refund
preconditions: Order with one line removed earlier
steps: 1. Cancel the order
expected: Refund equals what is still held (no double refund); the removed line is not restocked; a substituted line restocks the substitute.

title: Stock is restored on cancellation
steps:
1. Place then cancel an order
2. Check stock on /shop/inventory
expected: Stock returns to the pre-order figure with an inventory movement recorded.

title: Refund is idempotent
steps: 1. Send the cancel request twice quickly
expected: One refund only.

title: Cancelled orders never reach a settlement
steps: 1. Prepare settlements after cancelling an order
expected: The order is in no batch.

title: Accept timeout is enforced
steps: 1. Leave a CONFIRMED order unaccepted for 30+ minutes
expected: The order is auto-cancelled at the timeout with a full refund (see the accept-timeout cases added 4-Oct). Record the threshold seen.
source: Status report GS-034 / GS-066; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Unaccepted order is auto-cancelled with a full refund
steps: 1. Place an order and leave it unaccepted past the timeout
expected: Order CANCELLED with reason shop did not accept; full refund; stock restored; customer and shop notified once.

title: Timeout boundary and setting
steps:
1. Accept an order just before the timeout
2. Change the timeout in /admin/settings and repeat
3. Restore the default
expected: An order accepted in time is not cancelled. The new value takes effect for new orders.

title: Timeout for an order placed while the shop is closed
preconditions: Order placed with the closed-shop confirmation
steps:
1. Wait longer than the timeout while the shop is still closed
2. Wait after opening time
expected: The order is not cancelled while the shop is closed; the timer runs from opening time.

title: Auto-cancel refund follows the payment method
steps: 1. Let a wallet order, an online order and a COD order time out
expected: Wallet: wallet credit. Online: refund to source. COD: nothing to refund. Each cancelled exactly once.

title: Shop is alerted to a new order
steps:
1. Customer places an order
2. Shop opens /shop and /shop/orders
expected: New order appears under awaiting acceptance; in-app notification (and email) received.

title: Accept an order
steps: 1. Click Accept
expected: Status ACCEPTED; customer notified.

title: Reject an order with a reason
steps: 1. Reject with reason 'Closed today'
expected: Order cancelled; full refund; stock restored; customer notified with the reason.

title: Reject without a reason
steps: 1. Submit reject with an empty reason
expected: Refused with a field message.

title: Start picking and pick each line
steps:
1. Start
2. Pick each line
expected: Status PREPARING; each line shows picked.

title: Mark READY
steps: 1. Pack -> Ready (once with all lines picked, once without explicit picks)
expected: Status READY both times (pending lines are taken as picked); rider search starts automatically.

title: Propose a substitute
preconditions: A line is out of stock; the shop has a similar buyable product
steps: 1. Choose Substitute and pick a product from the same shop
expected: Customer is notified and sees an approve/reject choice on /orders. Order cannot be marked READY while the decision is pending.

title: Customer approves a cheaper substitute
steps: 1. Approve
expected: Substitute stock consumed; price difference refunded to the wallet at once; order total lowered; refund shown on the order.

title: Customer never pays more for a substitute
preconditions: Substitute costs more than the original line
steps: 1. Approve
expected: Charged at the original line price - no extra debit.

title: Customer rejects a substitute
steps: 1. Reject
expected: Line removed and refunded; order continues with the remaining lines.

title: Invalid substitutes are refused
steps: 1. Propose a product from another shop, an offline-only product, an out-of-stock product, and one with a different unit count
expected: Each refused.

title: Only the ordering customer can decide a substitution
steps: 1. As Customer 2, PATCH the substitution of Customer 1's order

title: Remove a line
steps: 1. Remove one line with reason 'Out of stock'
expected: Line refunded immediately; total lowered; customer notified.

title: Removing every line cancels the order
steps: 1. Remove all lines
expected: Order cancelled with the remainder (incl. delivery fee) refunded.

title: Pickup code is shown to the shop only
steps: 1. Open the order on /shop/orders
expected: Pickup code visible to the shop. The delivery OTP is never visible to the shop.

title: Subscription order still follows the one-click path
steps: 1. CONFIRMED -> PREPARING directly
expected: Allowed.

title: Shop order tabs
steps: 1. Check new, accepted, preparing, ready, completed and cancelled views
expected: Each order appears in exactly one view matching its status.

title: Shop on a held order cannot advance it
steps: 1. Try to accept a new order or advance a held order
expected: Refused with a clear message; orders left to continue can be completed.

title: READY triggers an offer automatically
preconditions: One approved rider online within range
steps: 1. Shop marks READY
expected: Rider receives an offer within seconds without the shop pressing anything.

title: Only online, approved riders are offered
preconditions: Rider A offline, Rider B online
steps: 1. Mark READY
expected: Only B is offered. A suspended or unapproved rider is never offered.

title: Nearer rider is preferred
preconditions: Two online riders with equal history at different distances
steps: 1. Mark READY
expected: The nearer rider gets the first offer.

title: Busy rider is ranked lower
preconditions: Rider A on an active delivery, Rider B free
steps: 1. Mark a second order READY
expected: A free rider is preferred. A busy rider is ranked lower instead of excluded (see the GA-005 cases added 4-Oct).
source: Status report GA-005; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Offer expires after 2 minutes
steps: 1. Let the offer lapse
expected: Offer disappears after about 120 s and the next rider is tried.

title: Decliner is never re-offered the same order
steps: 1. Rider A declines
expected: Rider B is offered; A never sees that order again. No order ever has two active assignments.

title: No rider available: bounded search
steps: 1. Mark READY and watch
expected: 'Looking for a rider - attempt 1 of 10...' and one 'Looking for a rider' notification. Attempts continue every retry interval (60 s).

title: Search stops at the limit
steps: 1. Leave it until 10 attempts / 30 min, or promised time + 15 min
expected: Search stops; status says why; shop notified once ('No rider found'); button becomes 'Try finding a rider again'.

title: 'Find rider now' respects the manual cooldown
steps: 1. Press 'Find rider now' twice within 30 s
expected: Second press is refused / disabled until the cooldown ends.

title: Restart and stop a search
preconditions: Search stopped; a rider now online
steps:
1. Press 'Try finding a rider again'
2. In another run press 'Stop searching'
expected: Restart resets the attempt counter and offers the rider. Stop ends the search ('You stopped the search').

title: Cancelling the order ends the search
steps: 1. Cancel during a search
expected: Search closes as 'order cancelled'; no further offers.

title: Dispatch rule changes take effect
steps:
1. Change dispatch retry interval / limits in /admin/settings
2. Start a new search
3. Restore default
expected: New values apply to the new search.

title: Concurrent orders do not double-book a rider
steps: 1. Mark two orders READY at the same moment
expected: Rider is offered one; the other waits or goes to the next rider.

title: Operator assigns and reassigns
steps:
1. /admin/orders: 'Assign rider' on a READY order
2. 'Reassign' with a reason on a live delivery
3. Reassign after pickup
expected: Assign and reassign work (ASSIGNED -> READY -> new offer). Reassign after pickup is blocked.

title: Shop/customer cannot call the assign API
steps: 1. POST /api/orders/{id}/assign as shop owner of another shop and as customer

title: Exclusive society: only listed riders are offered
preconditions: Society with exclusive riders and a non-empty list; listed rider L and unlisted rider U online
steps: 1. Order to a society address reaches READY
expected: Only L is offered. If L is offline, U is still not offered and the shop is told (society wording).

title: Non-exclusive society: listed and preferred riders first
preconditions: Non-exclusive society; riders preferred P, listed L, unlisted U all online at similar distance
steps: 1. Mark READY; let each offer lapse in turn
expected: Offer order: P, then L, then U.

title: Empty rider list never blocks dispatch
preconditions: Exclusive society with an empty list
steps: 1. Mark READY
expected: Any eligible rider is offered.

title: Revoking a rider takes effect immediately
steps: 1. Revoke L, then mark a new order READY
expected: L is not offered.

title: Reliability influences ranking
preconditions: Two riders at equal distance; one with recent failures/declines
steps: 1. Mark READY
expected: The more reliable rider is offered first.

title: Fairness: riders with fewer offers today are favoured
preconditions: Two equal riders; one already received several offers today
steps: 1. Mark READY
expected: The rider with fewer offers today is offered first; nobody is starved over several orders.

title: Dispatch cron endpoint is protected
steps: 1. POST /api/cron/delivery-dispatch, /api/cron/notifications, /api/cron/risk-rules, /api/cron/finance-weekly, /api/cron/daily-orders with no token and with a wrong token
expected: 403 each; nothing runs.

title: Busy rider is ranked lower, not excluded
preconditions: Rider 1 on a delivery; Rider 2 free
steps:
1. Mark an order READY
2. Repeat with only Rider 1 online
expected: Rider 2 is offered first. With only the busy rider online, Rider 1 is offered instead of the search failing.

title: Two orders batched to one rider
preconditions: Two READY orders at Shop A for nearby addresses
steps:
1. Let dispatch run
2. Rider picks up both and delivers in sequence
expected: Both offered as one trip; each order keeps its own pickup code and delivery OTP; earnings recorded per order.

title: Batching limits
steps:
1. Create more READY orders than the batch limit
2. Create two orders in opposite directions
3. Cancel one order of a batch after pickup
expected: No batch above the limit; far-apart drops are not batched; the remaining order still completes and the cancelled one follows the cancellation rules.

title: Rider on a batch sees only the current drop
steps: 1. During drop 1 request the details of drop 2
expected: Address and contact of the next drop are revealed only when it becomes the active drop.

title: Rider accepts an offer
steps: 1. Accept within 2 minutes
expected: Order ASSIGNED; progress chips shown; pickup has a 'Navigate to the shop' link; drop shows area only with a note that the full address appears after pickup.

title: Accept after expiry or when the order is no longer READY
steps:
1. Accept an expired offer
2. Accept after the order was cancelled
expected: Refused.

title: Arrived at the shop
steps: 1. Tap 'I've arrived at the shop' twice
expected: Chip ticks; shop notified once; the second tap is harmless.

title: Pickup with the wrong then the right code
steps:
1. Enter a wrong pickup code
2. Enter the code read out by the shop
expected: Wrong refused. Right: PICKED_UP; shop and customer notified.

title: Start delivery reveals the drop details
steps: 1. Tap 'Start delivery'
expected: Status OUT_FOR_DELIVERY; full address, landmark/instructions and 'Navigate to the customer' appear; customer now sees a delivery OTP on My Orders.

title: Arrived at the customer
steps: 1. Tap 'I've arrived at the customer'
expected: Customer notified 'Your rider has arrived'; for a society order the wording follows the entry mode.

title: Deliver with the customer OTP
steps: 1. Enter the OTP the customer reads out
expected: DELIVERED; rider earning credited; customer and shop notified; finance snapshot created.

title: Wrong OTP five times locks the delivery
steps: 1. Enter a wrong OTP 5 times, then the right one
expected: After 5 the right OTP is refused; only operations can complete it.

title: Operations override with a proof note
preconditions: Locked or OTP-less delivery after pickup
steps:
1. POST confirm-delivery with a proofNote
2. Without a note
3. As shop owner
expected: With note: DELIVERED and audited. Without: 422. Shop owner: 403.

title: Rider never receives codes or customer identity
steps: 1. Inspect the rider dashboard and the JSON of /api/delivery-partner/deliveries and PATCH /api/delivery-orders/{id} at every stage
expected: No pickupCode, deliveryOtp or handoverCode, and no customer name or phone, in any page or response - only needsPickupCode / needsDeliveryOtp flags.

title: Failed delivery
steps: 1. Report 'Customer not reachable'
expected: Order FAILED; shop notified; rider earning credited per the failed-delivery rule; shop can mark RETURNED which cancels and refunds.

title: Navigation links open Google Maps
steps: 1. Tap both Navigate links
expected: Google Maps opens with the right destination (deep link; no in-app navigation).

title: Online / offline toggle
steps: 1. Go offline, mark an order READY, go online
expected: No offer while offline; offers resume when online.

title: Rider application
steps:
1. Open /delivery-partner/apply or /register
2. Submit with required profile, vehicle, KYC and bank details
3. Submit with a missing required field
expected: Application created for review; missing fields flagged.

title: Admin reviews a rider
steps: 1. Move an application to under review, approve; reject another with a reason; suspend, reactivate and deactivate an approved rider
expected: Each transition works and is audited; the rider is notified; only APPROVED riders can go online.

title: Rider KYC is stored encrypted and not displayed
steps: 1. Open /gig/profile
expected: Vehicle type and registration shown; identity and bank details are not displayed. Profile is read-only.

title: Gig portal pages
steps: 1. Open /gig/orders and /gig/profile as: an unregistered user, a non-approved rider, an approved rider with and without an active job
expected: Unregistered: apply call-to-action. Non-approved: no action links. Approved: 'My deliveries' with active job and history (history excludes the active row).

title: Tracking API privacy
preconditions: An order at ASSIGNED and at PICKED_UP
steps:
1. GET /api/tracking/{orderId} as the customer, the shop owner, the assigned rider, an operator, another customer and a rider who declined
2. Use a bad uuid
expected: Allowed: customer, shop owner, assigned rider, operator. Denied: others. Coordinates only after pickup. Bad uuid: 422. ETA is null, never NaN.

title: Live tracking screen
steps: 1. Look for a map/tracking view on /orders for an order out for delivery
expected: Record whether any tracking view exists. Known gap: the component is not mounted and nothing posts rider location.

title: Legacy self-delivery by a shop
steps: 1. READY -> OUT_FOR_DELIVERY -> DELIVERED from the shop screen
expected: Allowed while no rider is active on the order.

title: Suspended rider's active delivery
steps:
1. Suspend the rider
2. Check /admin/orders
expected: Delivery stays assigned and disappears from the rider's app; operations can reassign it. Record behaviour (known gap).

title: Photo proof of delivery
steps:
1. Take a photo at handover and complete the delivery
2. Customer and operator open the order
expected: Photo is saved with time and shown to the customer and operations on the order.

title: Invalid or missing delivery photo
steps:
1. Try to complete with no photo where one is required
2. Upload an oversized file and a PDF renamed .jpg
expected: Delivery cannot complete without a valid photo where required. Invalid files are refused with a message.

title: Delivery photos are private
steps: 1. As another customer, another rider and a guest request the photo address

title: Partner states KYC_PENDING and DELIVERING
steps:
1. A rider applies without KYC documents
2. Operations approve after KYC
3. The rider accepts and completes a job
expected: KYC_PENDING until documents are in; APPROVED after review; DELIVERING during the job and available again after.

title: BLOCKED partner
steps:
1. Block the rider
2. Rider tries to go online and to accept an offer
expected: No offers are made, online is refused, any offer in hand lapses. An active delivery is handled by operations.

title: Illegal partner transitions
steps: 1. Try REJECTED -> DELIVERING and BLOCKED -> APPROVED without a reason
expected: Refused; state unchanged.

title: Rider edits vehicle details
steps: 1. Change vehicle type and registration on the profile and save
expected: Saved and shown. Record whether the change needs re-verification before the next job.

title: Rider edits bank details
steps:
1. Enter a new account number and IFSC
2. Confirm with the code sent to the rider
expected: Saved only after the code. Shown masked. Payouts go to the new account only after operations verify it; the rider is notified of the change.

title: Invalid rider profile edits
steps:
1. Enter a bad IFSC, an account number with letters and a vehicle number with symbols
2. Edit bank details with a wrong confirmation code
expected: Each refused with a field message; stored details unchanged.

title: Rider cannot edit another rider or self-approve KYC
steps:
1. PATCH the profile of another rider
2. Send status = APPROVED or kyc = VERIFIED in the own profile update
expected: 403 for the other rider. Status fields in the request are ignored; a KYC change returns the rider to review.

title: Register a society
steps: 1. Open /society -> register with name, address, PIN
expected: Society created as APPLIED; the registrant is its ADMIN (pending verification).

title: Duplicate society name + PIN
steps: 1. Register the same name and PIN again
