expected: Refused.

title: Operator verifies, rejects, suspends and reinstates
steps: 1. /admin/societies -> verify one, reject one with a reason, suspend then reinstate the verified one
expected: Status changes each time and is audited. On verification the registrant gets the SOCIETY_ADMIN navigation role.

title: Resident asks to join and is approved
steps:
1. Customer requests to join with a unit label
2. Society admin approves
3. Another request is declined
expected: Membership PENDING then ACTIVE; declined request cannot link addresses.

title: Cannot join an unverified society
steps: 1. POST /api/societies/{id}/members for an APPLIED society
expected: Refused.

title: Member role management and last-admin protection
steps:
1. ADMIN promotes a member to OPERATOR
2. OPERATOR tries to change a role
3. The only ADMIN tries to leave or demote themselves
expected: Role change by ADMIN works; OPERATOR is refused; the last admin cannot be removed.

title: Leaving a society clears address links
steps: 1. Leave the society
expected: Address is no longer linked; future orders carry no society.

title: Society dashboard
steps: 1. Open /society/{id}
expected: Sections: rules, residents, authorised riders, partner shops, deliveries.

title: Society dashboard shows no customer PII
steps: 1. Inspect the deliveries list and GET /api/societies/{id}
expected: No resident contact details and no order contents.

title: Residents and other societies' staff are kept out
expected: Resident and cross-society staff: 403. Platform operator: allowed.

title: Add an authorised rider by mobile
steps: 1. Add the mobile; mark preferred; add an unknown mobile
expected: Rider listed (and preferred); unknown mobile refused with a message. Each change audited.

title: Revoke a rider
steps: 1. Revoke
expected: Removed from the list immediately and audited.

title: Society rules: gate notes, entry mode, security desk
steps:
1. Set delivery instructions, entry mode 'Security calls the resident', a security-desk contact, 'show to rider' on, 'tell resident at gate' on
2. Rider takes a job to the society
3. Turn 'show to rider' off
expected: Rider sees the gate mode, notes and a tap-to-call desk number on the active job only. With 'show to rider' off the number is hidden.

title: Security notification on rider acceptance (opt-in)
steps:
1. Enable security notifications
2. A rider accepts a society order
3. Disable and repeat
expected: Society staff notified only when enabled.

title: Partner shops are recommended to residents
steps:
1. Society admin adds Shop A as a partner
2. Resident browses
expected: Shop A appears first for residents and counts as serviceable for them.

title: Society authorised delivery end to end
preconditions: Exclusive society, one listed rider, security notice on
steps: 1. Resident orders to the society address -> shop READY -> listed rider accepts -> pickup -> gate -> OTP delivery
expected: Order carries the society; only the listed rider is offered; security is notified on acceptance; rider sees gate notes; delivery completes; the dashboard shows the delivery without PII.

title: Suspended society
steps:
1. Suspend a society with members and linked addresses
2. Place an order to a linked address
expected: Record behaviour: society rules should stop applying; order still deliverable under normal dispatch.

title: Create a daily milk subscription
preconditions: Wallet funded; subscribable product at Rs 70/L
steps:
1. Shop page -> Subscribe on Cow Milk
2. Set 2 L/day
3. Check the cost preview
4. Subscribe
expected: Preview: Rs 140 per delivery, Rs 980 for 7 days. Subscription page opens; subscription ACTIVE.

title: Daily order is generated and charged once
preconditions: CRON_SECRET available, or wait for the scheduled run
steps:
1. Run the daily-orders cron for the start date
2. Run it again
expected: First run: one CONFIRMED order tagged 'subscription', wallet reduced by Rs 140. Second run: generated 0, no second debit.

title: Weekly schedule on chosen weekdays
steps:
1. Create a WEEKLY subscription for Mon/Wed/Fri
2. Open the calendar
expected: Calendar shows deliveries only on those days with estimated cost. WEEKLY without weekdays is refused.

title: Change tomorrow's quantity only
steps:
1. Override tomorrow to 3 L
2. Check the calendar for tomorrow and the day after
expected: Tomorrow Rs 210 and marked overridden; the day after reverts to 2 L. Removing the override restores 2 L.

title: Skip a date
steps:
1. Skip a future date
2. Run the cron for that date
expected: No order and no deduction for that date.

title: Pause and resume
steps:
1. Pause from D+2 to D+5
2. Check the calendar
3. Resume
expected: No deliveries inside the window (inclusive); resume restores them; resume/cancel notifications are sent; history shows each action.

title: Cancel a subscription
steps: 1. Cancel with a reason
expected: CANCELLED; no further orders; notification sent.

title: Final states are locked
steps: 1. Call pause, resume, skip and PATCH on it
expected: All refused; resume does not revive it.

title: Past or processed dates cannot be changed
steps: 1. Skip / override yesterday and a date already generated
expected: Refused.

title: Insufficient balance on a subscription day
steps:
1. Run the cron for the date
2. Top up
3. Retry that day from the subscription page
expected: No order; day marked failed for insufficient balance; customer notified; history row written. After top-up, retry creates the order and debits once.

title: Subscription history
steps: 1. Open the subscription's history
expected: Rows for paused, resumed, skipped, cancelled and payment-failed events.

title: Subscription pages are owner-only
steps: 1. As a shop owner / rider / society admin open /subscriptions/{id} of a customer
expected: Refused (owner or SUBSCRIPTION_MANAGE_ANY only).

title: Subscription order flows through fulfilment and dispatch
preconditions: Subscription to a delivering shop, address linked to a society
steps:
1. Generate the order
2. Shop prepares and marks READY
3. Rider delivers
expected: Order carries the address snapshot and society; rider gets a drop address; settlement snapshot is created at DELIVERED.

title: Shop unavailable on a subscription day
steps: 1. Run the cron
expected: No order; customer told delivery is unavailable; counted under 'unavailable'.

title: Subscription from a closed shop is unaffected by the closed-shop prompt
steps: 1. Generate a subscription order while the shop is closed
expected: Order created normally (no confirmation needed).

title: Draft subscription
steps:
1. Start a subscription and leave before confirming
2. Return and activate it
expected: Saved as DRAFT with no orders or charges; ACTIVE after confirmation.

title: Renewal pending
preconditions: Subscription reaching the end of its period
steps:
1. Let it reach the end date
2. Renew one; ignore another
expected: RENEWAL_PENDING with a notice. Renewed: ACTIVE. Ignored: COMPLETED with no further orders.

title: Daily cycle ORDER_CREATED and FULFILLED
steps:
1. Run the daily job
2. Deliver the order
expected: The day shows ORDER_CREATED, then FULFILLED after delivery, in the subscription history.

title: Drafts and illegal transitions
steps:
1. Run the daily job with only a DRAFT
2. Try DRAFT -> FULFILLED and COMPLETED -> ACTIVE through the API
expected: A draft never creates an order or charge. Illegal moves are refused.

title: Open the return form
preconditions: Order delivered within the last 48 h
steps: 1. /orders -> Return items
expected: Form lists lines with returnable quantity, condition, per-item comment, photos, reason list (CHANGED_MIND absent by default) and the window end.

title: Photo required for 'Damaged'
steps:
1. Submit reason Damaged with no photo
2. Add a photo and submit
expected: First refused. Second: return created 'Under review'; shop notified.

title: Quantity and duplicate guards
steps:
1. Return more than delivered
2. Return the same item twice
expected: Refused with the maximum returnable.

title: Return window passed
preconditions: Order delivered more than 48 h ago
steps: 1. Try to return
expected: Refused: window passed.

title: Shop approves a return
steps: 1. /shop/returns -> view photos -> Approve
expected: Approved; customer notified; a rider pickup is offered.

title: Shop rejects a return
steps: 1. Reject with a reason
expected: Rejected; the customer sees the reason on /returns/{id}.

title: Rider accepts the return pickup
steps: 1. Accept in the 'return pickup' panel
expected: Return -> Pickup assigned; customer sees a handover code and can choose a pickup time (-> Pickup scheduled).

title: Handover code check at pickup
steps:
1. Set off
2. Enter a wrong code
3. Enter the right code
expected: Wrong refused (5 tries, then operations only). Right: Pickup completed; flat fee credited to the rider. Rider never sees the code.

title: Rider could not collect
steps: 1. Report 'could not collect'
expected: Return back to Approved; customer and shop notified; shop can 'Find a rider again'.

title: Inspect and refund (full and partial)
steps:
1. Goods received -> Inspect -> Accept full
2. In another return accept a partial amount
expected: Approved for refund -> Refund initiated -> Refund completed; wallet credited with the right amount; ledger/settlement shows the shop's share; notification sent.

title: Inspect and reject
steps: 1. Inspect -> Reject
expected: Return rejected; no refund.

title: Return to a shop that does not deliver
steps:
1. Approve the return
2. Mark 'Customer handed goods over'
expected: No rider pickup; moves straight to inspection.

title: Customer cancels a return
steps:
1. Cancel before the rider sets off
2. Try after set-off
expected: First works (pickup cancelled). Second refused (contact support); operations can still cancel.

title: Refund retry is exactly-once
preconditions: A return stuck at Refund initiated
steps: 1. Retry refund twice
expected: Completes once; no double credit.

title: Return evidence photos are private
steps:
1. As another customer GET /api/images/{id} of the evidence
2. As the shop owner and as staff
expected: Other customer: 404. Shop owner and staff: allowed.

title: Returns rule changes
steps:
1. Enable CHANGED_MIND and change the window / charge-to in /admin/settings
2. Create a new return
3. Restore default
expected: New requests follow the new rule.

title: Operator refunds a delivered order (full / partial)
steps:
1. /admin/finance (or returns) -> refund part of the order charged to SHOP
2. Refund the rest charged to PLATFORM
expected: Wallet credited each time; full refund moves the order to REFUNDED; shop-share maths applied (never the delivery fee); audited.

title: Over-refund and replay are refused
steps:
1. Refund more than what remains
2. Re-send the same requestId
expected: Over-refund 422. Replay refunds once.

title: Customer and shop cannot approve refunds
steps: 1. POST /api/finance/refunds as shop owner and as customer

title: Disputed order handling
steps:
1. Mark an order DISPUTED
2. Prepare settlements
3. Check /admin/exceptions
4. Resolve it (refund or back to DELIVERED)
expected: Disputed order is excluded from settlement and appears in the exceptions queue; resolving releases it. Exactly one finance snapshot exists after it returns to DELIVERED.
source: Status report GS-058; Dev log Slice 6

title: Customer follows a return
steps: 1. Open /returns and /returns/{id}
expected: Status timeline matches each step taken above.

title: Admin returns queue
steps: 1. Open /admin/returns
expected: All returns with status; operations can cancel or complete a locked pickup.

title: Report a problem on an order
steps: 1. /orders -> Report a problem -> category PRODUCT, description
expected: Ticket created and linked to the order; reference shown; visible to operations.

title: Cannot report on someone else's order
steps: 1. POST /api/orders/{otherOrderId}/issue

title: Validation on the issue form
steps: 1. Submit with empty description and with an invalid category
expected: Field errors; no ticket.

title: Public grievance form and ticket lookup
steps:
1. Open /grievance, submit a complaint
2. Look the ticket up by its reference
expected: Ticket created with a reference; lookup shows its status without exposing other tickets.

title: Operations work a grievance
steps: 1. Admin console -> grievances: assign, move to IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED, CLOSED
expected: Statuses move OPEN -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> CLOSED; SLA counters update; the customer is notified.

title: Rate a shop after delivery
steps: 1. Rate the shop 4 stars with a comment
expected: Saved; shop average and count update; review appears on the shop page without the customer's identity.

title: Rating eligibility
steps:
1. Rate an undelivered order
2. Rate the same order twice
3. Rate another customer's order
4. Score 0 and 6
5. An order delivered more than 30 days ago
expected: All refused.

title: Rate the rider
preconditions: Order delivered by a platform rider
steps:
1. Rate the rider
2. Check a shop-self-delivered order
expected: Rider rating saved; rider and operations see the average; not public. No rider-rating option when the shop delivered itself.

title: Moderation hides and restores a rating
steps: 1. /admin/ratings -> hide a rating with a reason -> restore
expected: Hidden rating leaves the public list and the average; restore brings it back.

title: Only moderators can hide ratings
steps: 1. PATCH /api/ratings/{id} as the shop owner

title: Contact a shop
steps: 1. Open /shops/{slug}/contact
expected: Page loads with the shop's contact options; no customer data leaks.

title: Grievance moves through the full ladder
steps: 1. Move it OPEN -> TRIAGED -> INVESTIGATING -> RESOLUTION_PROPOSED -> RESOLVED -> CLOSED
expected: Each step saves with who and when; the customer sees the current state on ticket lookup.

title: Escalation
steps:
1. Customer rejects the proposed resolution
2. In another ticket let the response time pass
expected: Both become ESCALATED and reach the senior queue with a notification.

title: Illegal grievance transitions and who may move a ticket
steps:
1. Try OPEN -> CLOSED and CLOSED -> INVESTIGATING
2. As the customer set a staff-only state through the API
expected: Refused; state unchanged; the customer gets 403 on staff states.

title: Register a shop
steps: 1. /shop/register -> fill name, owner, phone, address, PIN, at least one category, delivery settings, and one of Shop Act / PAN (+holder name) / Udyam -> Submit
expected: Shop created as PENDING_APPROVAL with a registration number; user gains SHOP_OWNER; /shop shows the pending state.

title: At least one business identifier is required
steps:
1. Submit with none of the three
2. PAN without holder name
expected: 422 with the fields highlighted.

title: Identifier format validation
steps: 1. Enter PAN 'ABCDE12345', Udyam as a bare 12-digit number, Shop Act 'NA' / '0000'
expected: Each refused with a field message. Valid values in mixed case with spaces/hyphens are accepted and normalised.

title: At least one category is required
steps: 1. Submit with no category
expected: Refused.

title: Double-click creates one registration
steps: 1. Double-click Submit
expected: Button disables at once with a spinner; exactly one shop is created.

title: Typed values survive a server error
steps: 1. Submit a form that will be refused (duplicate)
expected: Error shown; the form keeps everything typed.

title: Duplicate by Shop Act licence
preconditions: Shop X pending with Shop Act S
steps: 1. From another account register a different name with S written with different spacing/case
expected: 409: identifier shown masked, message says it is already registered and waiting; nothing about the other shop is revealed.

title: Duplicate by PAN / Udyam at the same place
preconditions: Shop X approved with PAN P at PIN 411038
steps:
1. Register with P, same PIN and same name or first address line
2. Register with P at a different PIN and name
expected: First blocked. Second allowed (a branch).

title: Same account, same name, same PIN
steps: 1. Owner submits the same shop again while it is pending
expected: Blocked; /shop/register warns about the owner's own pending shop.

title: Rejected shop can be corrected and resubmitted
steps: 1. Follow the resubmit link from /shop -> correct -> submit
expected: The same record is updated (same registration number) and returns to PENDING_APPROVAL.

title: On-blur duplicate pre-check
steps:
1. Type a duplicate identifier and leave the field
2. Send more than 20 checks in a minute
expected: Early warning shown (CLEAR / DUPLICATE / RESUBMISSION). 429 after 20 per minute. Identifiers are sent by POST, never in the URL.

title: Operator approves a shop with a classification
steps: 1. Approve as KESARI (and another as GREEN)
expected: APPROVED; classification saved with history; owner notified; shop appears on the storefront.

title: Operator rejects a shop
steps: 1. Reject with a reason
expected: REJECTED; owner notified with the reason; shop never public.

title: Approve a rejected shop whose licence is now held by another
steps: 1. Approve it

title: Classification change needs a reason and is not available to owners
steps:
1. Owner POSTs classification
2. Operator changes it without a reason, then with one
expected: Owner 403. No reason: refused. With reason: saved to immutable history.

title: GST submission and verification
steps:
1. Owner submits a GSTIN
2. Operator verifies; for another shop rejects with a reason
expected: Status moves through pending -> verified / rejected and is shown to the owner.

title: PAN submission, masking and reveal
steps:
1. Owner submits a PAN
2. Operator views the queue
3. Operator uses reveal
4. Customer/other owner calls /api/shops/{id}/pan/reveal
expected: PAN is masked everywhere; reveal is permission-gated and audited; others get 403.

title: Invalid GSTIN / PAN formats
steps: 1. Submit malformed values
expected: Refused with field messages.

title: Seller compliance fields
steps: 1. Save legal name, FSSAI number and return policy
expected: Saved and shown where the storefront requires them.

title: KYC document upload
steps: 1. Look for a document upload on the shop's KYC screens
expected: Record whether one exists (known gap: numbers only, no documents).

title: Registration fee schedule and snapshot
steps:
1. Set a registration fee
2. Register a new shop
3. Change the fee
expected: The shop's fee is snapshotted at registration; later fee changes do not alter existing shops; fee history is kept.

title: Record a shop payment and reverse it
steps:
1. Record a part payment, then the balance
2. Reverse one payment
expected: fee_payment_status moves PENDING -> PARTIALLY_PAID -> PAID; payments cannot be edited or deleted, only reversed; amount paid recalculates.

title: Approval is gated on fee payment
steps: 1. Approve a shop whose fee is unpaid
expected: Approval is refused while the fee is unpaid and succeeds after a verified payment.
source: Status report GS-008; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Owner sees own registration and payment history only
steps:
1. Open the registration panel
2. GET /api/shop-payments for another shop
expected: Own data shown read-only; another shop's refused.

title: Shop referral codes
steps:
1. Create a referral code
2. Register a shop with it
3. View performance
expected: Shop attributed to the code; performance count rises. (No customer referral programme exists.)

title: Admin manages shop categories
steps:
1. /admin/shop-categories: add a category, rename, remove
2. Try to delete 'General'
expected: Changes save with a Save confirmation; 'General' cannot be deleted; removing a category does not delete products.

title: Assign several categories to a shop
steps: 1. /admin/shops/{id}/categories: add two categories, remove one
expected: Saved; the shop shows under each category on the storefront; products of an added category surface to the shop owner. With NEW-009 record whether an operator-added category also adds the products at stock 100 (TC-CAT-053).

title: Category permissions
steps: 1. As shop owner call POST/DELETE /api/shop-categories and PUT /api/shops/{otherShop}/categories
expected: Record which are allowed for owners; cross-shop change must be 403. An owner adding a category to the own shop must be allowed for NEW-009 (TC-CAT-037).

title: Shop profile and settings
steps:
1. Edit hours, delivery flag and fee, free-delivery threshold, prep time, description, logo
2. Edit location / pickup point
expected: Saved and reflected on the shop page.

title: Suspension impact preview
preconditions: Shop with open orders in several statuses
steps: 1. Admin shop management -> Suspend...
expected: Panel lists each open order with its planned action, the counts (cancel & refund / shop finishes / hold) and the refund value, before confirming.

title: Suspend a shop
steps: 1. Confirm with a reason and expected action
expected: Shop SUSPENDED. CONFIRMED orders cancelled and refunded with restock; PICKED_UP / OUT_FOR_DELIVERY continue; ACCEPTED / PREPARING / READY / ASSIGNED are held. Response summarises the impact.

title: Owner sees the suspension notice
steps: 1. Owner opens /shop
expected: Red banner with reason, effective time, what to do and what happened to orders; matching notification and email.

title: Customers cannot buy from a suspended shop
steps: 1. Browse and try to check out an existing cart
expected: Shop absent from lists; items unavailable; checkout refuses.

title: Decide held orders
steps: 1. /admin/suspensions: 'Let the shop finish it' on one, 'Cancel & refund' on another
expected: First proceeds; second cancelled with full refund; outcome recorded; owner notified. A held READY order is not dispatched until decided.

title: Reinstate the shop
steps: 1. Reinstate
expected: APPROVED; held orders go back to the shop; owner notified; ordering works again.

title: Suspension policy is configurable
steps:
1. Change the suspension rule (READY -> CONTINUE)
2. Suspend another shop
3. Restore default
expected: Preview and outcome follow the new policy.

title: Suspend from the risk page applies the same policy
steps: 1. /admin/risk -> 'Suspend & mark actioned' on a shop flag
expected: Suspension applies the policy and notice; flag closes as ACTIONED with 'Suspended: <reason>'.

title: Concurrent suspend / reject
steps: 1. Send two suspends (or a suspend and a reject) together
expected: One succeeds, the other 409; only one audit row.

title: Operator registers a shop on behalf of an owner
steps:
1. POST /api/shops with ownerId as OPERATOR
2. Same body as a CUSTOMER
expected: Operator: created for that owner. Customer: ownerId and fee fields are ignored (no privilege escalation).

title: Shop moves KYC_PENDING -> PAYMENT_PENDING -> VERIFIED -> ACTIVE
steps:
1. Owner uploads KYC documents
2. Operations verify KYC
3. Fee payment is recorded and verified
4. Operations approve
expected: The state shown to owner and operations follows each step and ends ACTIVE; only then is the shop listed.

title: A shop that is not ACTIVE cannot sell
preconditions: Shops in KYC_PENDING, PAYMENT_PENDING and VERIFIED
steps:
1. Search for each shop
2. Try to add its product to a cart through the API
expected: Not listed and not orderable in any of these states.

title: Owner closes the shop
preconditions: ACTIVE shop with one open order
steps:
1. Close the shop
2. Check the open order and the storefront
expected: State CLOSED. The shop disappears from search; the open order is completed or cancelled with a refund by rule; reopening needs operations.

title: Illegal shop transitions
steps: 1. Try KYC_PENDING -> ACTIVE, REJECTED -> ACTIVE and CLOSED -> ACTIVE directly
expected: Refused; state unchanged.

title: KYC documents uploaded against the shop
steps:
1. Upload GST certificate, PAN, FSSAI and Shop Act documents
2. Operator opens the shop KYC
expected: Each document is stored against the shop and visible to the owner and operations. One overall KYC status is shown.

title: KYC document validation
steps:
1. Submit with a mandatory document missing
2. Upload an oversized file, an .exe and an HTML file renamed .pdf
expected: Submission is refused until mandatory documents are present. Bad files are refused by content, not name.

title: KYC documents are private
steps:
1. As another owner, a customer and a guest request the document address
2. Try a guessed document id
expected: 403 / 404 every time. Addresses cannot be guessed or shared.

title: Operations reject a document and the owner re-uploads
steps:
1. Reject one document with a reason
2. Owner replaces it
expected: Overall KYC status shows rejected with the reason; after re-upload it returns to review. History is kept.

title: Product master: create and edit a product
steps:
1. Admin product management -> add a product with name, category, brand, pack size, GTIN, HSN, GST rate
2. Edit it
expected: Saved with a system product code; appears in catalogue search.

title: Shop-created product needs approval before other shops see it
steps:
1. Shop adds a new product not in the master
2. Check the duplicate suggestion
3. Operator approves/rejects in the product approval queue
expected: Duplicate suggestions are offered. Until approved only the creating shop sees it.

title: Map a master product to the shop
steps: 1. /shop -> add product from the catalogue with online price, offline price, stock
expected: Listing created and visible on the shop page.

title: Enabling a channel requires its price
steps:
1. Enable online sale with no online price
2. Negative price
3. Zero price
4. Leave the price empty on a loose product with online sale off
expected: Refused. An empty price is accepted only while online sale is off (NEW-008); switching online sale on then asks for a price.

title: Owner price change is immediate and logged
steps: 1. /shop/prices -> change a price
expected: Live at once; price history row and audit entry written.

title: Operator price change needs owner approval
steps:
1. Operator edits a shop's price
2. Owner approves; for another, rejects
3. Admin overrides one
expected: Operator change returns pending (202) and the live price is unchanged until the owner approves. Reject leaves it. Admin override applies. All audited.

title: Selling price above a verified MRP is refused
preconditions: Packaged product with verified MRP Rs 50
steps:
1. Set online price Rs 51 via form, API and Excel
2. Set Rs 50 and Rs 49
3. Same on a loose product
expected: Above MRP refused everywhere ('above the MRP'). Equal or below accepted. Loose products unaffected. Loose products have no MRP check and start with an empty price (NEW-008). Where a shop has set its own MRP (NEW-010) the check uses that shop MRP (TC-CAT-063) - confirm this rule with the owner.

title: Discount display is valid
steps: 1. View the product card
expected: MRP struck through, price 45, discount 10%. No discount shown when price = MRP; never a negative discount. The MRP used is that of the shop being viewed (NEW-010).

title: Admin sets an MRP
steps:
1. /admin/mrp -> set an MRP with source
2. Shop owner tries the same API
expected: Saved with source/verification, history and audit. Owner gets 403. The 403 applies to the admin (master) MRP API. The owner changes the MRP for the own shop through the shop screen instead (TC-CAT-057).

title: Lowering an MRP below a shop's price
steps: 1. Lower the MRP below Shop A's price
expected: Shop notified; its price unchanged; it appears under 'Shop prices above the MRP'. A shop-specific MRP set by the owner is not overwritten (TC-CAT-060).

title: MRP correction claim by a shop
steps:
1. 'MRP looks wrong?' -> claim a value
2. Operations accept; in another case reject
expected: MRP unchanged until decided; accept updates it, reject restores status. This claim concerns the master MRP. With NEW-010 the owner can also change the MRP for the own shop at once (TC-CAT-057); confirm both paths are meant to remain.

title: Record and verify an external price reference
steps: 1. /admin/price-references -> record (product code, price, source, URL, location, date) -> Verify; Reject another (note required); Reopen
expected: Each status change works with history. No shop price or MRP changes as a result.

title: Excel upload by the owner: validate, preview, apply
steps:
1. Download the price template
2. Edit prices
3. Upload
4. Review the preview
5. Apply
expected: Preview shows old vs new with counts; apply updates prices in one transaction; audit and price history written. Loose rows have a blank price in the template (TC-CAT-033).

title: Excel validation errors
steps: 1. Upload: a non-Excel file renamed .xlsx, an oversized file, missing columns, a negative price, text in a price cell, duplicate rows, an unknown product code, and a cell starting with '=' or '+'
expected: Each reported row-by-row in an error report; nothing applied; formula-like cells are sanitised, not executed.

title: Excel upload by an operator creates pending requests
steps: 1. Operator uploads prices for a shop
expected: Changes queue for the owner's approval instead of applying.

title: Customer cannot upload product lists
steps: 1. POST /api/excel-uploads

title: Update stock
steps: 1. /shop/inventory -> change stock on a listing
expected: Saved; an inventory movement is written; storefront availability follows. Applies equally to listings created at stock 100 by a category add (TC-CAT-052).

title: Stock reduces on order and never goes negative
steps:
1. Order 2 units of a product with stock 5
2. Check inventory
expected: Stock 3; reserved/available/on-hand consistent (on-hand = available + reserved).

title: Low-stock threshold resolution
steps: 1. Set shop default 10, a product default via API, and a listing threshold 3
expected: Effective threshold follows listing -> product -> shop and the table shows its source.

title: Low-stock alert fires once per crossing
steps:
1. Buy stock down through the threshold
2. Buy again while still low
3. Restock
expected: One alert and one notification on crossing; none while it stays low; alert resolves on restock.

title: Reorder level and quantity
steps: 1. Set reorder level and quantity on a listing
expected: Saved and shown with the low-stock list on the dashboard.

title: Product photos: add, primary, reorder, replace, delete
steps: 1. /shop/products/{id}/images: add several, make one primary, move left/right, replace one, delete the primary
expected: Order and primary persist; the next photo becomes primary on delete; product card, cart and gallery update.

title: Image upload validation
steps: 1. Upload a 6 MB file, a PDF renamed .jpg, an SVG/HTML renamed .jpg, a 20x20 px image, a 4000 px phone photo
expected: First four refused with clear messages (content is sniffed, not trusted by name). The large photo is accepted after browser-side shrink.

title: Another shop cannot edit your photos
steps: 1. As owner B call the image APIs for owner A's listing

title: Image upload rate limit
steps: 1. Upload repeatedly in a short burst
expected: 429 after the limit.

title: Specifications display
steps: 1. View a product with specifications text
expected: Shown escaped; no HTML injection.

title: Loose product has no default price in the master catalogue
preconditions: One loose product (sold by weight) in the master
steps:
1. Open the loose product in admin product management
2. Check price and MRP
expected: No default price is held or shown for a loose product. The field is empty, not 0.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Loose product added to a shop starts with an empty price
preconditions: Shop A does not yet list the loose product
steps:
1. Add the loose product to the shop
2. Open it on /shop/prices
3. Read the stored value (API or database)
expected: Price field is empty for the owner to fill. Stored value is null, not 0.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Customer never sees Rs 0 for an unpriced loose product
preconditions: Shop A lists a loose product with no price
steps: 1. Open the shop page, the product page and search results
expected: The product shows a 'price not set' style label instead of Rs 0 or a blank amount, with no Add button. No discount or MRP strike-through.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Unpriced product cannot be added to a cart or ordered
steps:
1. POST /api/cart with the listing id
2. POST /api/checkout with it
expected: Both refused with a clear reason. No cart line, no order, no debit at Rs 0.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Owner sets the price of a loose product
steps:
1. Enter Rs 60 per kg and save
2. View it as a customer
expected: Saved with price history and audit. Product becomes buyable and shows Rs 60 per kg.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Loose price field accepts empty but not zero or invalid values
steps:
1. Save with the price empty
2. Enter 0, -5, abc and 10.555
expected: Empty is accepted and the product stays unpriced. Zero, negative, text and more than 2 decimals are refused.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Excel template and upload keep loose prices empty
steps:
1. Download the price template
2. Check the loose rows
3. Upload it back with the loose price cells blank
4. Upload with 0 in a loose price cell
expected: Loose rows are blank in the template, not 0. Blank is accepted as unpriced and nothing is set to 0. A 0 is reported as an error.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Unpriced loose product in search and price comparison
preconditions: Shop A unpriced, Shop B priced for the same loose product
steps:
1. Search the product
2. Open Compare prices
expected: Shop B row is buyable and can carry 'Lowest price'. Shop A row is marked price not set, not buyable and sorted after buyable rows.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Price cleared while the product is in a cart
preconditions: Priced loose product in Customer 1 cart
steps:
1. Owner clears the price
2. Customer reloads the cart and tries to pay
expected: Line is flagged not purchasable with a reason; pay is disabled until it is removed.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008); TC-CART-007

title: Loose products that already had a shop price keep it
preconditions: Loose listing priced before the change
steps: 1. Open the listing after the new build is deployed
expected: The price the shop had set is unchanged. Only products with no shop price are empty.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: loose goods price empty (NEW-008)

title: Adding a category adds every product in it to the shop
preconditions: Shop C approved with no products; category X has a known number of master products
steps:
1. As owner of Shop C add category X
2. Open /shop/inventory
expected: Every active master product of category X is now a listing of Shop C. The count equals the master count for the category.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Each added product starts with stock 100
steps:
1. Check on-hand, reserved and available for each new listing
2. Open the inventory movements
expected: On-hand 100, reserved 0, available 100 for each. One opening movement of +100 per listing, marked as created by the category add.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Product with a catalogue price gets that price as the starting price
preconditions: Category X holds a packaged product with a price / MRP in the master
steps: 1. Open that listing on /shop/prices
expected: Price is pre-filled from the catalogue and can be edited by the owner. It never exceeds the MRP.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Product with no catalogue price is left for the owner to price
preconditions: Category X holds a product with no price in the master
steps:
1. Open that listing
2. Look for a list of products needing a price
3. Set a price
expected: Price is empty. The listing is counted under a 'needs price' list and is not buyable online until the owner sets a price, after which it is buyable.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Loose products in the category are added with an empty price
preconditions: Category X holds a loose product
steps: 1. Open the loose listing
expected: Added with an empty price, whatever the catalogue holds. Record the unit of the stock figure 100 (kg, litre or pieces).
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Products the shop already lists are left untouched
preconditions: Shop A already lists one product of category Y at stock 7 and its own price
steps:
1. Shop A adds category Y
2. Open that listing
expected: Stock stays 7 and the price stays as set. No second listing of the same product.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Adding the same category twice creates no duplicates
steps:
1. Double-click Add on a category
2. Send the add request twice through the API
3. Add category X again
expected: One listing per product. Stock is not raised to 200 or reset to 100. No duplicate opening movement.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Two categories sharing a product give one listing
preconditions: A product belongs to categories X and Z
steps: 1. Add X then Z
expected: The shared product is listed once with stock 100.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Only approved, active master products are added
preconditions: Category X also holds an inactive product, a merged duplicate and a product another shop created that is still pending
steps:
1. Add category X
2. Check the listings
expected: Inactive, merged and pending products are not added.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Category with no products
steps: 1. Add it
expected: Category is added; no listings created; a clear message, no error.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Large category is added completely
preconditions: A category with several hundred products
steps:
1. Add it and time it
2. Count the listings
expected: All products are added or none (no partial result). No timeout or 500. The owner sees progress or a completion message.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Other shops are not affected
preconditions: Note Shop B listing count and stock
steps:
1. Shop C adds category X
2. Re-check Shop B
expected: Shop B listings, stock and prices are unchanged.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Owner cannot add a category to another shop
preconditions: Owner A; Shop B belongs to another owner
steps:

2. Send it as a customer and as a guest
expected: 403 / 401 each time. No listing or stock created for Shop B.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Added products appear on the storefront correctly
steps: 1. Open the Shop C page
expected: Priced products are in stock and buyable. Unpriced products are not buyable and show no Rs 0.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: No false low-stock alerts; the add is audited
steps:
1. Check notifications and the low-stock list after the add
2. Admin opens the audit log
expected: No low-stock alert for listings at 100. One audit entry for the category add with the product count.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Owner corrects the default 100 to the real stock
steps: 1. Change one added listing to 12 and another to 0
expected: Saved with movements. The 0 listing shows out of stock on the storefront.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009); TC-CAT-017

title: Category added by an operator or admin for the shop
steps: 1. /admin/shops/{id}/categories: add a category to Shop C
expected: Record whether the products are auto-added at 100. The requirement names the shop owner only; confirm the intended behaviour.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009); TC-ONB-027

title: Category chosen at shop registration
preconditions: New shop registered with category X, then approved
steps: 1. After approval open /shop/inventory
expected: Record whether the registration category fills the inventory (on approval) or only categories added later do. Confirm with the owner.
source: New requirement 3-Oct: category add fills inventory at 100 (NEW-009)

title: Product added to the master category later
preconditions: Shop C already has category X
steps:

steps: 1. Read console messages on home, shop, cart, orders, wallet, /shop, /delivery-partner, /admin
expected: No uncaught errors or hydration warnings.

title: Legal and policy pages
steps: 1. Open terms, privacy, refund, shipping, seller terms, subscription terms, voucher terms, wallet terms, cookie policy, grievance redressal, /about, /contact
expected: All load with content.

title: Unsaved-changes guard on edit screens
steps: 1. Change a field on an admin edit screen and navigate away
expected: Warning shown before losing changes.

title: Empty states
steps: 1. Open /orders, /subscriptions, /returns, /cart, notifications
expected: Each shows a helpful empty state, not a blank page or error.

title: Sign in: mobile number
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 9 digits, then 11 digits
3. Enter 5876543210 (first digit below 6)
4. Enter letters, symbols and a number with spaces
5. Enter +91 followed by a valid number
6. Enter a valid 10-digit number starting 6-9
expected: Blank, wrong length, wrong first digit and non-digits each show a message on the field and nothing is saved or sent. +91 is either stripped or refused, the same way every time (record which). The valid number is saved exactly. No code is sent for a refused number.

title: Sign in: email
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter abc, abc@, @x.com and 'a b@x.com'
3. Enter an address longer than 254 characters
4. Enter a valid address in capitals with a space before and after
expected: Bad formats and over-long values show a field message; nothing is sent or saved. The valid address is trimmed and stored in lower case. No code or link is sent for a refused address.

title: Sign in: verification code
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters
4. Paste the right code with spaces around it
5. Enter the right code
expected: Only the exact code is accepted. Short, long and non-numeric entries are refused on the field (record whether they count towards the attempt limit). A pasted code with spaces is cleaned or refused, the same way every time.

title: Sign up: terms consent box
steps:
1. Try to continue with the box unticked
2. Tick it and continue
3. Send the sign-up through the API without the consent value
expected: Sign-up is refused until consent is given, on the page and through the API. Consent is recorded with time and version.

title: Profile: name
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed. Header initial follows the saved name.

title: Profile: gender
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422).

title: Profile: mobile (add / change)
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 9 digits, then 11 digits
3. Enter 5876543210 (first digit below 6)
4. Enter letters, symbols and a number with spaces
5. Enter +91 followed by a valid number
6. Enter a valid 10-digit number starting 6-9
7. Enter a number already linked to another account
expected: Blank, wrong length, wrong first digit and non-digits each show a message on the field and nothing is saved or sent. +91 is either stripped or refused, the same way every time (record which). The valid number is saved exactly. A number linked to another account is refused without revealing whose it is.

title: Profile: new email
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter abc, abc@, @x.com and 'a b@x.com'
3. Enter an address longer than 254 characters
4. Enter a valid address in capitals with a space before and after
5. Enter the current email
6. Enter an email used by another account
expected: Bad formats and over-long values show a field message; nothing is sent or saved. The valid address is trimmed and stored in lower case. Same email and an email of another account are refused.

title: Profile: email-change code
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters
4. Paste the right code with spaces around it
5. Enter the right code
expected: Only the exact code is accepted. Short, long and non-numeric entries are refused on the field (record whether they count towards the attempt limit). A pasted code with spaces is cleaned or refused, the same way every time. Email stays unchanged until the right code is entered.

title: Address: type (Home / Work / Other)
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422).

title: Address: recipient name
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed.

title: Address: recipient mobile
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 9 digits, then 11 digits
3. Enter 5876543210 (first digit below 6)
4. Enter letters, symbols and a number with spaces
5. Enter +91 followed by a valid number
6. Enter a valid 10-digit number starting 6-9
expected: Blank, wrong length, wrong first digit and non-digits each show a message on the field and nothing is saved or sent. +91 is either stripped or refused, the same way every time (record which). The valid number is saved exactly.

title: Address: flat / house and street lines
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed. The rider sees the lines exactly as saved.

title: Address: landmark
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly.

title: Address: city and state
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
8. Enter a PIN and check whether city and state fill in by themselves
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed. Record whether they are filled from the PIN and whether they can be overtyped.

title: Address: PIN code
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters and symbols
4. Enter 000000 and a PIN starting with 0
5. Enter a valid 6-digit PIN
6. Enter a valid PIN that is far from the map pin
expected: Only a 6-digit PIN that does not start with 0 is accepted. Every other value shows a message on the field and is refused by the API (422). Record what happens when PIN and map pin disagree; serviceability must use one consistent rule.

title: Address: map pin / coordinates
steps:
1. Save without placing a pin
2. Place and drag the pin, save and reload
3. Send latitude 95 and longitude 200 through the API
4. Send text as coordinates
expected: Without a pin the address saves as PIN-only (or a pin is asked for, the same way every time). The dragged position persists. Out-of-range and non-numeric coordinates are refused (422).

title: Address: default flag
steps:
1. Mark the second as default
2. Send default = true for both through the API
3. Delete the default address
expected: Exactly one default at any time. Deleting the default is refused or another address becomes default.

title: Address: society link
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422). A society the user does not belong to is refused.

title: Location bar: PIN
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters and symbols
4. Enter 000000 and a PIN starting with 0
5. Enter a valid 6-digit PIN
expected: Only a 6-digit PIN that does not start with 0 is accepted. Every other value shows a message on the field and is refused by the API (422). The previous location stays in place after a refused PIN.

title: Address search (Places) box
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
6. Type 2 characters
7. Type a place outside India
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Suggestions appear after the minimum length; a place outside India cannot be saved as a delivery address.

title: Search box (products and shops)
steps:
1. Search with it blank
2. Enter 1 character, then 200 characters
3. Enter % _ ' " and <script>alert(1)</script>
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a product name with spaces before and after
expected: No 500 for any input. Symbols are treated as text and shown escaped. Outer spaces are ignored. Empty and no-match searches show a clear message.

title: Cart: quantity (packaged product)
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0
3. Enter -1
4. Enter 1.5
5. Enter text
6. Enter 99999999
7. Enter a normal whole number
8. Enter 5, then 6
expected: Negative, decimal, text and out-of-range values are refused with a field message and by the API. The normal value saves and shows after reload. 0 removes the line or is refused, the same way every time. 5 is accepted; 6 is refused OUT_OF_STOCK.

title: Cart: quantity (loose product by weight)
steps:
1. Enter 0 and a negative weight
2. Enter 0.0005 kg
3. Enter 250 g, 1.5 kg
4. Enter more than the stock
5. Enter text
expected: Only weights the shop sells (within the step and stock) are accepted. The line total is price x weight to the paisa. Quantity is sent in milli-units.

title: Checkout: delivery address
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
4. Send the address id of another user through the API
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422). An address of another user is refused (403 / 404); no order.

title: Checkout: delivery window
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
4. Send a window that has already passed through the API
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422). A past or unoffered window is refused.

title: Checkout: payment method
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send 'CHEQUE' through the API
expected: Wallet, Cash on delivery (where the shop allows it) and Online are accepted. A method not on the list is refused (422).
source: Request 3-Oct: field-level testing; TC-PAY-007; Updated 4-Oct (feature treated as completed)

title: Checkout: order notes
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Notes reach the shop unchanged.

title: Checkout: delivery instructions
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Instructions reach the rider unchanged after pickup.

title: Wallet: top-up amount
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
7. Enter Rs 1 and Rs 1,00,000
8. Enter 99 paise and Rs 1,00,001
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Rs 1 and Rs 1,00,000 are accepted; below and above are refused. No payment is started for a refused amount.

title: Wallet: voucher code
steps:
1. Top up with the code blank
2. Enter an unknown code
3. Enter a valid code in lower case with spaces around it
4. Enter 100 characters and <script>
expected: Blank is fine (no bonus). Unknown code gives a clear message and no bonus. Case and outer spaces are handled the same way every time. No 500.

title: Wallet settings: low-balance threshold
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Blank or 0 switches the warning off (record which).

title: Wallet settings: auto-recharge amount and switch
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
7. Switch auto-recharge on with the amount blank
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Auto-recharge cannot be on without a valid amount inside the top-up limits.

title: Shop registration: shop name
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed.

title: Shop registration: owner name
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed.

title: Shop registration: phone
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 9 digits, then 11 digits
3. Enter 5876543210 (first digit below 6)
4. Enter letters, symbols and a number with spaces
5. Enter +91 followed by a valid number
6. Enter a valid 10-digit number starting 6-9
expected: Blank, wrong length, wrong first digit and non-digits each show a message on the field and nothing is saved or sent. +91 is either stripped or refused, the same way every time (record which). The valid number is saved exactly.

title: Shop registration: address lines
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter spaces only
3. Enter 1 character
4. Enter 300+ characters
5. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
6. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
7. Enter a normal value with spaces before and after
expected: Blank and spaces-only are refused with a field message. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is stored and shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Outer spaces are trimmed.

title: Shop registration: PIN
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters and symbols
4. Enter 000000 and a PIN starting with 0
5. Enter a valid 6-digit PIN
expected: Only a 6-digit PIN that does not start with 0 is accepted. Every other value shows a message on the field and is refused by the API (422).

title: Shop registration: categories
steps:
1. Submit with nothing chosen
2. Choose each option in turn and save
3. Send a value that is not in the list through the API
4. Choose several categories
expected: An empty required choice is refused. Each listed option saves and shows after reload. An unlisted value is refused (422). At least one is required; several can be chosen.

title: Shop registration: Shop Act licence number
steps:
1. Leave it blank with a PAN given
2. Leave all three identifiers blank
3. Enter symbols and 100 characters
4. Enter a valid number in lower case with spaces
expected: Blank is fine when another identifier is given; all three blank is refused. Bad characters and over-long values are refused. Case and spaces are normalised so duplicates are still caught.

title: Shop registration: PAN and holder name
steps:
1. Enter 9 and 11 characters
2. Enter ABCDE12345 and 12345ABCDE (wrong pattern)
3. Enter abcde1234f (lower case)
4. Enter a valid PAN with the holder name blank
5. Enter a valid PAN and holder name
expected: Only the pattern AAAAA9999A is accepted; lower case is converted or refused, the same way every time. Holder name is required with a PAN. After saving, the PAN is shown masked.

title: Shop registration: Udyam number
steps:
1. Enter UDYAM-MH-00 (too short)
2. Enter the digits without the UDYAM- prefix
3. Enter a valid UDYAM-XX-00-0000000 number
expected: Only the full Udyam pattern is accepted.

title: Shop settings: GSTIN
steps:
1. Enter 14 and 16 characters
2. Enter a state code of 00 or 99
3. Enter a GSTIN whose middle part is not the shop PAN
4. Enter a GSTIN with a wrong last (check) character
5. Enter a valid GSTIN
expected: Only a 15-character GSTIN with a valid state code and check character is accepted. Record whether a PAN mismatch is refused or only flagged for the operator.

title: Shop settings: FSSAI number
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 13 and 15 digits
3. Enter letters
4. Enter 14 digits
expected: Blank is accepted where FSSAI is optional. Only 14 digits are accepted otherwise.

title: Shop settings: legal name and return policy
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly.

title: Shop registration: delivery settings (delivers, fee)
steps:
1. Choose delivers = yes with the fee blank
2. Enter a negative fee and text
3. Choose delivers = no
expected: A delivering shop needs a valid fee (0 allowed for free delivery). Negative and text are refused. With delivery off the fee is not asked for.

title: Shop KYC: document upload
steps:
1. Submit with no file
2. Upload a file over the size limit
3. Upload a wrong type and a PDF / SVG renamed to .jpg
4. Upload an empty (0 byte) file
5. Upload a valid file
expected: Missing, oversized, wrong-type, disguised and empty files are refused with a clear message (content is checked, not the name). The valid file is accepted and shown. The document is visible to the owner and operations only.

title: Shop registration: referral code
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
6. Enter an unknown code
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. An unknown code gives a clear message and does not block registration (or blocks it, the same way every time).

title: Shop settings: delivery radius
steps:
1. Enter empty, 0, -1, 2.5, text
2. Enter 1 and 50
3. Enter 51
expected: Whole kilometres from 1 to 50 only. Everything else is refused (422) and the stored value is unchanged.

title: Shop settings: extra delivery PIN zones
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 5 digits, then 7 digits
3. Enter letters and symbols
4. Enter 000000 and a PIN starting with 0
5. Enter a valid 6-digit PIN
6. Add the same PIN twice
7. Add the shop own PIN
expected: Only a 6-digit PIN that does not start with 0 is accepted. Every other value shows a message on the field and is refused by the API (422). A duplicate PIN is refused or stored once.

title: Shop settings: minimum order value
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Blank or 0 means no minimum (record which).

title: Shop settings: opening hours
steps:
1. Set closing before opening
2. Set opening = closing
3. Set a day as closed
4. Set hours across midnight (22:00 to 02:00)
5. Send 25:00 through the API
expected: Impossible times are refused. Closed days and overnight hours save and drive the open / closed label in IST.

title: Shop settings: delivery fee and free-delivery threshold
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
7. Enter fee 0
8. Leave the threshold blank
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Fee 0 is accepted (free delivery). A blank threshold means the fee always applies.

title: Shop settings: preparation time
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0
3. Enter -1
4. Enter 1.5
5. Enter text
6. Enter 99999999
7. Enter a normal whole number
expected: Negative, decimal, text and out-of-range values are refused with a field message and by the API. The normal value saves and shows after reload. 0 is accepted or refused according to the form; record the allowed range.

title: Shop settings: description
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 300+ characters
3. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> and symbols
4. Enter Hindi / Marathi text
5. Enter a normal value
expected: Blank is accepted. Over-long text is cut or refused at the limit, never a 500 (record the limit). Script text is shown as plain text. Hindi / Marathi text saves and displays correctly. Line breaks are kept on the shop page.

title: Shop settings: logo
steps:
1. Submit with no file
2. Upload a file over the size limit
3. Upload a wrong type and a PDF / SVG renamed to .jpg
4. Upload an empty (0 byte) file
5. Upload a valid file
expected: Missing, oversized, wrong-type, disguised and empty files are refused with a clear message (content is checked, not the name). The valid file is accepted and shown. Without a logo the shop shows a neutral placeholder.

title: Shop settings: delivery, pause-orders and COD switches
steps:
1. Switch on, save and reload
2. Switch off, save and reload
3. Send a non-boolean value through the API
expected: The state persists both ways and takes effect where it should. A non-boolean value is refused. Delivery off: shop is not listed as delivering. Pause on: no new orders. COD on: customers are offered COD.

title: Shop listing: online price
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
7. Enter 51 (above the MRP)
8. On a loose product leave the price blank
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Above the MRP is refused. Blank is refused for a packaged product on sale online, and accepted for a loose product, which then stays unpriced.

title: Shop listing: in-shop (offline) price
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. Blank is accepted when in-shop sale is off.

title: Shop listing: MRP (own shop)
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0, then a negative amount
3. Enter text and symbols
4. Enter 3 decimal places (10.555)
5. Enter a very large amount (10,00,00,000)
6. Enter 70.50
7. Enter an MRP below the current price (45)
expected: Zero, negative, text, more than 2 decimals and out-of-range amounts are refused with a field message and 422 from the API. Rs 70.50 is stored as 7050 paise and shown as Rs 70.50. An MRP below the selling price is refused or the price must be lowered first. The saved MRP applies to this shop only.

title: Shop listing: stock quantity
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0
3. Enter -1
4. Enter 1.5
5. Enter text
6. Enter 99999999
7. Enter a normal whole number
8. On a loose product enter 2.5
expected: Negative, decimal, text and out-of-range values are refused with a field message and by the API. The normal value saves and shows after reload. 0 is accepted and shows out of stock. Decimals are accepted only for loose goods.

title: Shop listing: low-stock threshold
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0
3. Enter -1
4. Enter 1.5
5. Enter text
6. Enter 99999999
7. Enter a normal whole number
expected: Negative, decimal, text and out-of-range values are refused with a field message and by the API. The normal value saves and shows after reload. Blank falls back to the product or shop default.

title: Shop listing: reorder level and reorder quantity
steps:
1. Leave it blank
2. Enter 0
3. Enter -1
4. Enter 1.5
5. Enter text
6. Enter 99999999
7. Enter a normal whole number
expected: Negative, decimal, text and out-of-range values are refused with a field message and by the API. The normal value saves and shows after reload. Blank is accepted (no reorder hint).

title: Shop listing: sell online / sell in shop switches
steps:
1. Switch on, save and reload
2. Switch off, save and reload
3. Send a non-boolean value through the API
4. Switch online sale on with the price blank
expected: The state persists both ways and takes effect where it should. A non-boolean value is refused. Online sale cannot be on without a price.

title: Stock adjustment: quantity and reason
steps:
1. Enter 0, text and a decimal on a packaged product
2. Reduce by 11
3. Leave the reason blank
4. Add 5 with a reason
expected: Invalid quantities and a reduction below zero are refused. Record whether the reason is required. The valid entry writes a movement.

title: Product photo upload
steps:
1. Submit with no file
2. Upload a file over the size limit
